definition_zh: 太阳能；由太阳辐射转化而来的能量
definition_en: energy that comes from the sun's radiation and is used for heat or electricity
core_image: 一片深色面板铺在屋顶上，正午的阳光穿过玻璃落到面板表面
scene: 正午的荒漠边缘，一排排深色面板把直射的日光收进电网。 The desert station runs entirely on solar energy.
sceneCN: 这里 solar energy 指「由太阳辐射得到的能量」（第 1 个义项：太阳发出的光和热被收集后用于供热或发电）；句意为这座沙漠观测站完全依靠太阳能运行。图中可辨识物件：倾斜的光伏面板、电缆、日光光斑、远处的沙丘。

pos.zh: 太阳能（不可数复合名词）

senses.title: Sunlight collected as usable power
senses.titleCN: 被收集起来的太阳辐射
senses.definition: the light and heat of the sun once it has been captured for heating or generating electricity
senses.definitionCN: 太阳发出的光和热被捕获后用于供热或发电的部分
senses.example: The desert station runs entirely on solar energy.
senses.exampleCN: 这座沙漠观测站完全依靠太阳能运行。
senses.why: solar names the sun as source and energy names the capacity to do work, so the phrase literally means work-capacity supplied by the sun.
senses.whyCN: solar 指明来源是太阳，energy 指明做功的能力，因此这个短语字面就是「由太阳供给的做功能力」。

senses.title: The resource itself
senses.definition: sunlight treated as a natural resource that countries and companies plan around
senses.definitionCN: 被当作自然资源来规划利用的太阳光
senses.example: The region treats solar energy as its cheapest resource.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区把太阳能当作最便宜的资源。
senses.why: once people plan how much of something to use, they speak of it as a resource, and sunlight enters that same accounting.
senses.whyCN: 当人们开始规划用多少，就会把它说成资源，太阳光也就进入了同一套账目。

senses.title: Electricity from photovoltaic cells
senses.definition: electric current produced when panels of semiconductor cells are struck by sunlight
senses.definitionCN: 半导体电池板受日光照射时产生的电流
senses.example: Rooftop panels converted solar energy into direct current.
senses.exampleCN: 屋顶面板把太阳能转化成了直流电。
senses.why: the phrase narrows to electricity when engineers need a label for the input of a photovoltaic circuit.
senses.whyCN: 当工程师需要给光伏电路的输入端一个名称，这个短语就收窄为电力。

senses.title: Heat for water and buildings
senses.titleCN: 用于水和建筑的太阳热能
senses.definition: heat gathered from the sun to warm water, air or the interior of a building
senses.definitionCN: 从太阳收集来用于加热水、空气或建筑内部的热量
senses.example: The clinic heats its water with solar energy.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所利用太阳能加热水。
senses.why: heat is the older form of the phrase's use, since collectors warmed water long before panels made current.
senses.whyCN: 供热是这一短语更早的用法，因为在面板发电之前，集热器早已用来加热水。

senses.title: A policy and industry category
senses.definition: the sector, regulations and markets built around collecting the sun's power
senses.definitionCN: 围绕收集太阳能建立的行业、法规与市场
senses.example: The budget added tax credits for solar energy.
senses.exampleCN: 预算为太阳能增加了税收抵免。
senses.why: a physical input becomes a category when governments tax it, subsidize it and count jobs in it.
senses.whyCN: 当政府对其征税、补贴并统计就业，一种物理输入就变成了一个门类。

senses.title: Radiation in physics terms
senses.titleCN: 物理学意义上的太阳辐射
senses.definition: electromagnetic radiation emitted by the sun across a broad spectrum
senses.definitionCN: 太阳在宽广光谱范围内发出的电磁辐射
senses.example: Instruments measured solar energy across the visible spectrum.
senses.exampleCN: 仪器测量了可见光谱范围内的太阳辐射。
senses.why: physics keeps the literal reading and replaces 'usable' with a measurable flux of radiation.
senses.whyCN: 物理学保留字面读法，只把「可用」换成一个可测量的辐射通量。

senses.title: The emblem of clean power
senses.definition: a symbol used in debate for power that produces no smoke or carbon while running
senses.definitionCN: 在讨论中用来象征运行时不排烟、不排碳的电力
senses.example: The campaign put solar energy at the centre of its message.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动把太阳能放在其主张的中心。
senses.why: because the fuel arrives free and clean, the phrase came to stand for an entire environmental stance.
senses.whyCN: 因为燃料免费而清洁地到来，这个短语逐渐代表了一整套环保立场。

senses.title: Any free natural input
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何免费的自然输入
senses.definition: any freely arriving input that a system can convert into useful work
senses.definitionCN: 任何免费到来、可被系统转化为有用功的输入
senses.example: The team called public attention 'solar energy' for the project.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把公众的关注称作这个项目的「太阳能」。
senses.why: the metaphor works for anything that costs nothing to receive but needs a converter to become useful.
senses.whyCN: 凡是不花钱就能收到、却需要转换器才有用的东西，都适用这个比喻。

intro.en: Solar energy joins Latin sol 'sun' with Greek energeia 'activity'. Both elements came into English by separate learned routes, and the compound itself is a modern coinage. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: solar energy 把拉丁语 sol「太阳」与希腊语 energeia「活动」并置。两个成分分别经学术路径进入英语，整个复合词则是现代造词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Sol was the Latin word for the sun and also the name of the sun god. Its deeper origin is not established; the Indo-European form often cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: sol 是拉丁语中表示太阳的词，也是太阳神的名字。其更深来源未得到证明；常被引用的印欧语形式属于重构形式。

items.en: Sol plus the adjective ending -alis produced solaris 'of the sun', which passed through Old French and Middle English as solar.
items.cn: sol 加形容词词尾 -alis 构成 solaris「太阳的」，经古法语与中古英语成为 solar。

items.en: Energeia meant 'activity, operation', built from en- 'in' and ergon 'work'. Aristotle used it for actuality as opposed to mere capacity.
items.cn: energeia 意为「活动、运作」，由 en-「在内」与 ergon「工作」构成。亚里士多德用它指现实，与单纯的能力相对。

items.en: Seventeenth-century writers borrowed energia for vigour of style, and physics later narrowed energy to the capacity for doing work.
items.cn: 17 世纪的作者借 energia 指文风的力度，物理学后来把 energy 收窄为做功的能力。

items.en: Solar energy became a fixed phrase in the nineteenth century, when solar engines and solar water heaters were described in the technical press.
items.cn: solar energy 在 19 世纪成为固定短语，当时技术刊物已在描述太阳能发动机与太阳能热水器。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin root of sol is unsettled, and the exact first appearance of the compound in print is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：sol 在拉丁语之前的词根无定论，这个复合词的确切最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds forms built on Latin sol that look alike but do not all mean 'sun'; group two holds words for the same physical input under other names.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁 sol、形貌相近却并非都指「太阳」的词；第二组是同一物理输入的其他名称。

entries.definition: The adjective from sol, meaning 'of the sun'; it is the first element of the phrase, not a synonym for the whole phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 由 sol 来的形容词，意为「太阳的」；它是短语的第一个成分，不等同于整个短语。

entries.definition: Sol plus sistere 'to stand still': the moment the sun appears to stop in its yearly path.
entries.definitionCN: sol 加 sistere「停住」：太阳在周年路径上看似停住的那一刻，即至点。

entries.definition: A Latin word for a sun terrace, from sol; it is a place, not a form of power.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中指日光浴台的词，来自 sol；它指场所，不是能源。

entries.definition: From Latin solus 'alone', not sol 'sun'; the shared letters are coincidental and the words are unrelated in origin.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 solus「独自」，而非 sol「太阳」；相同的字母只是巧合，两词词源无关。

entries.definition: The light itself as it arrives; solar energy names that light once it is captured for use.
entries.definitionCN: 指到达地面的光本身；solar energy 指这些光被捕获可供使用之后的形态。

entries.definition: Usually the electrical output of solar systems, where solar energy can also mean the heat input.
entries.definitionCN: 通常指太阳能系统的电力输出，而 solar energy 也可指热输入。

entries.definition: A wider class that includes solar, wind, water and biomass; solar energy is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的类别，包含太阳能、风能、水能与生物质能；太阳能是其中一员。

entries.definition: The adjective for the cell technology that turns light into current, not a name for the energy itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指把光变成电流的电池技术的形容词，并非能量本身的名称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: sol 'sun' + -ar 'of': the phrase begins with the Latin name of the sun itself.
normal.cn: sol「太阳」+ -ar「…的」：短语开头就是太阳的拉丁名。

normal.en: Greek ergon 'work' is hidden inside energy, so energy means work-capacity.
normal.cn: energy 里藏着希腊 ergon「工作」，所以 energy 就是做功的能力。

normal.en: The family runs solar, solar energy, solar power, solar panel, solar cell.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 solar、solar energy、solar power、solar panel、solar cell。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the industry: solar energy system, solar energy storage, solar energy industry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出产业义：太阳能系统、太阳能储存、太阳能产业。

normal.en: The same sol root appears in solstice and solarium, both about the sun's position.
normal.cn: 同一 sol 词根出现在 solstice 与 solarium 中，都与太阳的位置有关。

abstract.en: Picture a leaf that never sends a bill for the light it uses.
abstract.cn: 想象一片叶子，从不为自己用的光开账单。

abstract.en: Picture a roof that quietly turns noon into a battery's stored afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象一片屋顶，把正午悄悄变成电池里储存的下午。

abstract.en: Picture a currency that is minted every morning whether or not anyone works.
abstract.cn: 想象一种货币，不管有没有人干活，每个早晨都会新铸出来。

examples.en: The village pumps its water with solar energy.
examples.cn: 这个村庄用太阳能抽水。

examples.en: Solar energy avoids the fuel costs of a diesel generator.
examples.cn: 太阳能免去了柴油发电机的燃料成本。

examples.en: The course explains how solar energy becomes household current.
examples.cn: 这门课讲解太阳能如何变成家庭用电。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「solar（太阳的）+ energy（能量）」——太阳送来的能量 → 太阳能

root: 拉丁 sol「太阳」+ 形容词词尾 -aris/-al；energy 来自希腊 energeia「活动、运作」= en-「在内」+ ergon「工作」。sol 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one flow: radiation arrives, is captured, becomes heat or current, then is counted as a resource, an industry, a scientific quantity, a political emblem and finally a metaphor for any free input.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条流程展开：辐射到达、被捕获、变成热或电流，随后被计为资源、产业、科学量、政治象征，最后成为任何免费输入的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark panel on a roof receiving noon light and passing it into wires.
core.cn: 核心意象：屋顶上的深色面板接住正午的光，把它送进电线。

branches.en: PHYSICAL ARRIVAL: radiation reaches a surface, whether measured in a lab or gathered on a roof.
branches.cn: 物理到达：辐射抵达表面，无论是在实验室测量还是在屋顶收集。

branches.en: RESOURCE: the arriving light is entered into plans and budgets as a supply.
branches.cn: 资源：到达的光被记入规划与预算，成为一种供给。

branches.en: CONVERTED FORMS: the same input leaves as electric current or as stored heat.
branches.cn: 转换形态：同一输入以电流或储存的热离开。

branches.en: INDUSTRY: laws, subsidies and markets turn the physical flow into a sector.
branches.cn: 产业：法律、补贴与市场把物理流动变成一个行业。

branches.en: EMBLEM AND METAPHOR: the phrase stands for clean politics, then for any free natural gift.
branches.cn: 象征与比喻：短语代表清洁政治，再引申为任何免费的自然馈赠。

intro.en: Solar energy is a compound of two learned borrowings: a Latin adjective and a Greek-derived noun. Its parts still build other English words, so the phrase can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: solar energy 是两个学术借词的复合：一个拉丁形容词加一个希腊来源名词。其成分仍在构成其他英语词，因此这个短语可以按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: Sol gives solar, solstice and solarium; Greek ergon, through energeia, gives energy, energetic and energize.
latinIntro.cn: sol 衍生 solar、solstice 与 solarium；希腊 ergon 经 energeia 衍生 energy、energetic 与 energize。

items.structure: Latin noun sol, solis (m., third declension)
items.example: The root names the source of the whole phrase.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名了整个短语的来源。

items.example: Solar means belonging to the sun.
items.exampleCN: solar 意为属于太阳的。

items.example: A solar collector faces the noon sun.
items.exampleCN: 太阳能集热器朝向正午的太阳。

items.example: The Greek noun supplied the scientific term for work-capacity.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊名词提供了表示做功能力的科学术语。

items.example: The panel converts light into electrical energy.
items.exampleCN: 面板把光转化成电能。

items.example: The reaction was unusually energetic.
items.exampleCN: 这个反应异常剧烈。

items.example: The circuit energizes the coil.
items.exampleCN: 电路给线圈通电。

items.meaningCN: 太阳供给的能量；太阳能
items.example: The desert station runs entirely on solar energy.
items.exampleCN: 这座沙漠观测站完全依靠太阳能运行。

items.meaningCN: 由光产生电流的；光伏的
items.example: Photovoltaic cells line the roof.
items.exampleCN: 屋顶铺满光伏电池。

latinEntries.structure: energia, -ae (f., first declension; from Greek energeia)

definition_zh: 风能；由流动空气推动涡轮转化而来的能量
definition_en: energy obtained from moving air, usually converted into electricity by turbines
core_image: 山脊上一排白色风机，叶片在强风中持续转动
scene: 开阔的草原山脊上，白色叶片顺风旋转，把转动送进远处的电网。 A row of turbines turns wind energy into household current.
sceneCN: 这里 wind energy 指「流动空气所携带、可被转化的能量」（第 1 个义项：风推动叶片转动后变成电力或机械功）；句意为山脊上的一排风机把风能变成家庭用电。图中可辨识物件：白色塔筒、旋转叶片、牧场围栏与输电线。

senses.title: Moving air as a source of power
senses.titleCN: 作为动力来源的流动空气
senses.definition: the power carried by air in motion, seen as something that can be captured and put to work
senses.definitionCN: 流动空气所携带的动力，被视为可被捕获并加以利用的东西
senses.example: A row of turbines turns wind energy into household current.
senses.exampleCN: 一排风机把风能变成家庭用电。
senses.why: wind names the moving air and energy names its capacity to do work, so the phrase reads as work-capacity carried by air in motion.
senses.whyCN: wind 指流动的空气，energy 指其做功能力，因此短语读作「流动空气所携带的做功能力」。

senses.title: Electricity from turbines
senses.definition: electric current produced when the turning of turbine blades drives a generator
senses.definitionCN: 涡轮叶片转动带动发电机时产生的电流
senses.example: The grid took wind energy only when the breeze held steady.
senses.exampleCN: 只有风速稳定时，电网才接收风电。
senses.why: the phrase narrows to electricity once the output of a generator is what is being metered and sold.
senses.whyCN: 当被计量与出售的是发电机输出，这个短语就收窄为电力。

senses.title: The resource counted in plans
senses.definition: the wind available over a site, measured and entered into energy plans
senses.definitionCN: 某一地点可获得的风，经测量后计入能源规划
senses.example: Engineers mapped wind energy along the coast for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师用十年时间测绘沿海的风能资源。
senses.why: planners treat a natural flow as a stock to be assessed, so the phrase becomes a quantity on a map.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把自然流动当作可评估的存量，于是这个短语成了地图上的一个量。

senses.title: Mechanical work from wind
senses.definition: the turning force used directly for milling grain, pumping water or sawing wood
senses.definitionCN: 直接用于磨谷、抽水或锯木的转动力
senses.example: The old mill used wind energy to grind wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老磨坊用风能磨小麦。
senses.why: before generators existed, wind did its work through shafts and stones, and this older reading still survives.
senses.whyCN: 在发电机出现之前，风通过轴与石磨做功，这一更早的读法仍然留存。

senses.title: A policy and industry category
senses.definition: the sector, subsidies and regulations built around turning wind into power
senses.definitionCN: 围绕把风变成电力建立的行业、补贴与法规
senses.example: The province set a target for wind energy in its five-year plan.
senses.exampleCN: 该省在五年规划中为风能设定了目标。
senses.why: a flow becomes a category when budgets, permits and jobs are organized around it.
senses.whyCN: 当预算、许可与就业围绕一种流动被组织起来，它就变成一个门类。

senses.title: Kinetic energy in meteorology
senses.definition: the kinetic energy of moving air masses, measured in physical units
senses.definitionCN: 移动气团所具有的动能，以物理单位计量
senses.example: The model estimated wind energy in the lower atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 该模型估算了低层大气中的风能。
senses.why: physics replaces the practical reading with a formula: half the mass times the square of velocity.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把实用读法换成一个公式：质量的一半乘以速度的平方。

senses.title: The emblem of clean power
senses.definition: a symbol in public debate for power that burns no fuel while it runs
senses.definitionCN: 公共讨论中象征运行时不烧燃料的电力
senses.example: The party made wind energy a test of its climate policy.
senses.exampleCN: 该党把风能当作其气候政策的试金石。
senses.why: the fuel is invisible and free, so the phrase easily stands for an environmental position rather than a machine.
senses.whyCN: 燃料看不见又免费，因此这个短语很容易代表一种环保立场，而不只是机器。

senses.title: Any momentum that can be harnessed
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何可被借用的势头
senses.definition: any moving force in a system that can be redirected to do useful work
senses.definitionCN: 系统中任何可被改变方向来做有用功的流动力量
senses.example: The director spoke of wind energy in the crowd's enthusiasm.
senses.exampleCN: 主管把人群的热情称作一股可利用的风能。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the physical shape: something is already moving, and a device only redirects it.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了物理形态：某物已经在动，装置只负责改变它的方向。

intro.en: Wind energy joins the native English noun wind with Greek energeia 'activity'. The first element is Germanic and the second learned, so the phrase mixes two layers of English vocabulary. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: wind energy 把英语本族名词 wind 与希腊语 energeia「活动」并置。前者属日耳曼层，后者属学术借词层，因此这个短语混合了英语词汇的两个层次。年代均为约数。

items.en: Old English wind meant 'air in motion' and descended from Proto-Germanic *windaz. The same Germanic stock gives Dutch wind and German Wind.
items.cn: 古英语 wind 意为「流动的空气」，源自原始日耳曼语 windaz。同一日耳曼来源也给出荷兰语 wind 与德语 Wind。

items.en: The noun goes back to a root meaning 'to blow', whose exact shape is a reconstruction. Latin ventus 'wind' is a distant cousin from the same root.
items.cn: 这个名词上溯到一个意为「吹」的词根，其确切形态属于重构形式。拉丁语 ventus「风」是同一词根的远亲。

items.en: Energeia meant 'activity, operation', built from en- 'in' and ergon 'work'; Aristotle used it for actuality.
items.cn: energeia 意为「活动、运作」，由 en-「在内」与 ergon「工作」构成；亚里士多德用它指现实。

items.en: Energia entered learned Latin for vigour of style, and physics later fixed energy as the capacity for doing work.
items.cn: energia 进入学术拉丁语指文风力度，物理学后来把 energy 固定为做功的能力。

items.en: Wind energy as a fixed phrase belongs to the age of wind turbines and wind farms, from the late nineteenth century onward.
items.cn: wind energy 作为固定短语属于风力涡轮机与风电场的时代，即 19 世纪末以后。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the exact first printed use of the compound is not recorded, and the Indo-European root behind wind is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：这个复合词最早的书证没有确切记录，wind 背后的印欧词根属于重构而非实证。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same wind element, including one that looks unrelated; group two holds other names for air in motion and for the power it carries.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 wind 成分的词，其中包括一个看似无关的词；第二组是流动空气及其所带动力 的其他名称。

entries.definition: The noun for moving air and the verb for twisting or making breathless are different words that happen to share a spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 指流动空气的名词与指缠绕或使喘不过气的动词是两个不同的词，只是拼写相同。

entries.definition: From Old Norse vindauga 'wind eye', a real compound of wind and eye, so it is a distant relative of wind energy.
entries.definitionCN: 来自古诺尔斯语 vindauga「风眼」，是 wind 与 eye 的真实复合，因此与 wind energy 有远亲关系。

entries.definition: A mill driven by wind; it names the machine, while wind energy names the input.
entries.definitionCN: 由风驱动的磨坊；它指机器，而 wind energy 指输入。

entries.definition: From windan 'to twist', a verb of different origin; a winding road has nothing to do with air.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 windan「缠绕」，是另一来源的动词；蜿蜒的路与空气无关。

entries.definition: Usually the electrical output of wind systems, where wind energy can also mean the resource or the mechanical input.
entries.definitionCN: 通常指风力系统的电力输出，而 wind energy 也可指资源或机械输入。

entries.definition: A gentle wind, especially one felt as pleasant; it is a kind of wind, not a form of power.
entries.definitionCN: 轻风，尤指令人舒适的风；它是风的一种，不是一种动力。

entries.definition: The movement of air around or through an object, used in engineering rather than in energy accounting.
entries.definitionCN: 空气绕过或穿过物体的运动，用于工程语境而非能源核算。

entries.definition: The wider class that includes wind, solar, water and biomass; wind energy is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的类别，包含风能、太阳能、水能与生物质能；风能是其中一员。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: wind + energy: the phrase simply names the moving air and the work it can do.
normal.cn: wind + energy：短语直接点名流动的空气与它能做的功。

normal.en: The family runs wind, windy, windmill, wind farm, wind turbine, wind power.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 wind、windy、windmill、wind farm、wind turbine、wind power。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the industry: wind energy capacity, wind energy sector, wind energy potential.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出产业义：风能装机容量、风能行业、风能潜力。

normal.en: Latin ventus 'wind' shares the same Indo-European root as English wind.
normal.cn: 拉丁 ventus「风」与英语 wind 共享同一印欧词根。

normal.en: The old mill is the physical ancestor of the turbine: both capture wind energy with a spinning shaft.
normal.cn: 老磨坊是涡轮机的物理祖先：两者都用旋转轴捕获风能。

abstract.en: Picture a sail that asks the sky for nothing but a push.
abstract.cn: 想象一张帆，只向天空要一阵推力，别无所求。

abstract.en: Picture a field of white trees whose leaves never stop turning.
abstract.cn: 想象一片白色树林，叶子从不停下转动。

abstract.en: Picture a river you cannot see, yet its current turns the wheels.
abstract.cn: 想象一条看不见的河，水流却在转动轮子。

examples.en: The island meets half its demand with wind energy.
examples.cn: 这座岛用风能满足一半需求。

examples.en: Wind energy cannot be stored cheaply without batteries.
examples.cn: 没有电池，风能难以低成本储存。

examples.en: The textbook explains how wind energy drives a generator.
examples.cn: 这本教材讲解风能如何驱动发电机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「wind（风）+ energy（能量）」——风带来的能量 → 风能

root: wind 为英语本族词，源自原始日耳曼语 windaz，更上溯到意为「吹」的印欧词根（重构形式），与拉丁 ventus「风」同根；energy 来自希腊 energeia「活动」= en-「在内」+ ergon「工作」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one flow: air moves, blades turn, a shaft spins, current or mechanical work leaves, and the same flow is then counted as a resource, an industry, a physical quantity, an emblem and a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条流程展开：空气流动、叶片转动、轴旋转、电流或机械功输出，随后同一流动被计为资源、产业、物理量、象征与比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white blades on a ridge turning wind into a spinning shaft.
core.cn: 核心意象：山脊上的白色叶片把风变成旋转的轴。

branches.en: PHYSICAL FLOW: moving air carries kinetic energy, whether measured in a formula or felt on a ridge.
branches.cn: 物理流动：流动空气携带动能，无论用公式测量还是在山脊上感受。

branches.en: CONVERTED OUTPUT: the turning shaft yields electric current or direct mechanical work.
branches.cn: 转换输出：旋转的轴产生电流或直接的机械功。

branches.en: RESOURCE: the wind over a site is surveyed and entered into plans.
branches.cn: 资源：某地的风被测绘并计入规划。

branches.en: INDUSTRY: subsidies, permits and markets turn the flow into a sector.
branches.cn: 产业：补贴、许可与市场把这一流动变成行业。

branches.en: EMBLEM AND METAPHOR: the phrase stands for clean politics, then for any momentum that can be redirected.
branches.cn: 象征与比喻：短语代表清洁政治，再引申为任何可被改向的势头。

intro.en: Wind energy combines a native Germanic noun with a Greek-derived noun. The native element still forms everyday compounds, while the Greek element forms the scientific vocabulary of work and power.
intro.cn: wind energy 把一个日耳曼本族名词与一个希腊来源名词组合起来。本族成分仍构成日常复合词，希腊成分则构成工作与动力的科学词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin ventus 'wind' is a distant relative of English wind; Latin turbo gives turbine, and Greek energeia gives energy, energetic and energize.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ventus「风」是英语 wind 的远亲；拉丁 turbo 衍生 turbine，希腊 energeia 衍生 energy、energetic 与 energize。

items.example: The wind rose before dawn.
items.exampleCN: 天亮前风大了起来。

items.example: A windy ridge suits a turbine.
items.exampleCN: 多风的山脊适合建风机。

items.example: The coast is windy in spring.
items.exampleCN: 海岸在春天多风。

items.example: The miller repaired the windmill.
items.exampleCN: 磨坊主修好了风车。

items.example: The Greek noun supplied the term for work-capacity.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊名词提供了表示做功能力的术语。

items.example: The blades convert moving air into energy.
items.exampleCN: 叶片把流动空气转化成能量。

items.example: The gust was energetic enough to bend the mast.
items.exampleCN: 那阵风强得足以吹弯桅杆。

items.meaning: a machine driven by a moving fluid
items.meaningCN: 由流动流体驱动的机器；涡轮机
items.example: A turbine converts flow into rotation.
items.exampleCN: 涡轮机把流动转化为旋转。

items.meaningCN: 流动空气供给的动力；风能
items.example: A row of turbines turns wind energy into household current.
items.exampleCN: 一排风机把风能变成家庭用电。

latinEntries.structure: energia, -ae (f., first declension; from Greek energeia)

definition_zh: 水力发电的；利用水流能量发电的
definition_en: producing electricity from the energy of falling or flowing water
core_image: 高坝把河水蓄成平静的湖面，闸口放出的水柱冲向机房里的水轮机
scene: 峡谷里的高坝把河水拦成深湖，闸口放出的水柱冲进下游机房。 The valley relies on a hydroelectric dam for power.
sceneCN: 这里 hydroelectric 指「利用水流的能量发电的」（第 1 个义项：以落差水流驱动涡轮产生电力）；句意为这个峡谷依靠一座水电站大坝供电。图中可辨识物件：弧形坝体、闸门水柱、机房、下游河道。

pos.zh: 水力发电的（多作定语，也可作表语）

senses.title: Generating power from water
senses.definition: using falling or flowing water to drive turbines and produce electricity
senses.definitionCN: 利用落差水流或流动的水驱动涡轮并产生电力
senses.example: The valley relies on a hydroelectric dam for power.
senses.exampleCN: 这个峡谷依靠一座水电站大坝供电。
senses.why: hydro- supplies 'water' and electric supplies 'producing current', so the adjective says the current is made from water.
senses.whyCN: hydro- 提供「水」，electric 提供「产生电流」，因此这个形容词表示电流由水而来。

senses.title: Belonging to such a plant
senses.titleCN: 属于此类电站的（定语义）
senses.definition: describing a dam, station or turbine that belongs to a water-power system
senses.definitionCN: 描述属于水力发电系统的坝、站或涡轮机
senses.example: The hydroelectric station employs forty local workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座水电站雇用了四十名当地工人。
senses.why: nouns like dam and station borrow the adjective to mark what kind of plant they are, so the word becomes a classifier.
senses.whyCN: dam、station 等名词借这个形容词标明电站种类，于是这个词成了分类标签。

senses.title: The electricity so produced
senses.titleCN: 这样发出的电（准名词义）
senses.definition: the current itself, when speakers shorten the noun phrase to the adjective
senses.definitionCN: 指电流本身，即说话人把名词短语省略后留下的形容词
senses.example: The grid buys hydroelectric from the mountain states.
senses.exampleCN: 电网从山区各州购买水电。
senses.why: English often lets an adjective stand for its noun, so hydroelectric can name the product as well as the process.
senses.whyCN: 英语常让形容词代替其名词，因此 hydroelectric 既可指过程，也可指产品。

senses.title: A branch of engineering and industry
senses.definition: the sector of design, construction and operation that builds water-power works
senses.definitionCN: 负责设计、建造与运营水力发电工程 的行业部门
senses.example: She trained as a hydroelectric engineer in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 她在北方接受水电站工程师的训练。
senses.why: a technique becomes a field when universities teach it and firms bid for its contracts.
senses.whyCN: 当大学开设课程、公司竞标合同，一种技术就变成一个领域。

senses.title: Hydraulic energy turned electric
senses.definition: the conversion of hydraulic energy into electrical energy in a machine
senses.definitionCN: 在机器中把水能转化为电能的过程
senses.example: The lab measured hydroelectric efficiency at ninety percent.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室测得水力发电效率为九成。
senses.why: physics uses the adjective for any process that changes hydraulic energy into electrical energy, whatever the scale.
senses.whyCN: 物理学用这个形容词指任何把水能变成电能的过程，不论规模。

senses.title: Low-carbon power in climate debate
senses.titleCN: 气候讨论中的低碳电力
senses.definition: power classed as low-carbon because no fuel is burned to make it
senses.definitionCN: 因发电不烧燃料而被归为低碳的电力
senses.example: The report counted hydroelectric as a clean resource.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把水电算作清洁资源。
senses.why: climate accounting groups technologies by emissions, and this label places water power among the clean ones.
senses.whyCN: 气候核算按排放给技术分组，这个标签把水电放进清洁一类。

senses.title: Converting an obvious natural fall
senses.titleCN: 抽象技术义：把现成落差转为可用形式
senses.definition: any system that converts a ready-made natural drop into a usable form of power
senses.definitionCN: 任何把现成的自然落差转化为可用动力的系统
senses.example: The engineers called the tide a hydroelectric opportunity.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把潮汐称作一个水力发电式的机会。
senses.why: the word's shape only requires a gradient and a converter, so it stretches to tides and even to data flows.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的构造只要求一个落差和一个转换器，因此可延伸到潮汐甚至数据流。

senses.title: Big dams and their social cost
senses.titleCN: 大型水坝及其社会代价的象征义
senses.definition: a shorthand in public debate for large dams, including the villages they displace
senses.definitionCN: 公共讨论中对大型水坝的简称，也含被其淹没的村庄
senses.example: The word hydroelectric carried a promise and a protest.
senses.exampleCN: 水力发电这个词既带着承诺，也带着抗议。
senses.why: large dams flood valleys, so the adjective acquired a social charge that has nothing to do with volts.
senses.whyCN: 大型水坝会淹没河谷，因此这个形容词带上了一层与电压无关的社会情绪。

intro.en: Hydroelectric joins Greek hydro- 'water' with electric, a seventeenth-century adjective coined from Greek elektron 'amber'. The compound itself is a nineteenth-century technical formation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydroelectric 把希腊语 hydro-「水」与 electric 组合起来；electric 是 17 世纪由希腊语 elektron「琥珀」造出的形容词。整个复合词是 19 世纪的技术造词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hydōr was the Greek noun for water, with an irregular declension. Its Indo-European ancestry is reconstructed, not directly attested.
items.cn: hydōr 是希腊语中表示水的名词，变格不规则。其印欧语来源属于重构形式，并非直接实证。

items.en: The combining form hydro- entered scientific compounds such as hydraulics, hydrogen and hydrosphere.
items.cn: 组合形式 hydro- 进入 hydraulics、hydrogen、hydrosphere 等科学复合词。

items.en: Ēlektron meant 'amber'. Rubbing amber produces static charge, and that observed property gave the name to the whole phenomenon.
items.cn: ēlektron 意为「琥珀」。摩擦琥珀会产生静电，这一观察到的性质把名字给了整个现象。

items.en: In the seventeenth century electricus 'like amber' was coined for bodies that attract light objects, and English electric followed.
items.cn: 17 世纪造出 electricus「像琥珀的」，指能吸引轻小物体的物体，英语 electric 随后出现。

items.en: Hydroelectric appeared in the nineteenth century once turbines and generators made falling water a practical source of current.
items.cn: 当涡轮机与发电机使落水成为实用的电流来源，hydroelectric 在 19 世纪出现。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Greek origin of elektron is unsettled, and no exact first citation for the compound is recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：elektron 在希腊语之前的来源无定论，这个复合词也没有确切的最早书证。

note.en: Group one holds words built on hydro- or on the electric stock that are easily confused; group two holds names for the same power under other labels.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 hydro- 或 electric 词干、容易混淆的词；第二组是同一动力的其他名称。

entries.definition: From Greek hydraulikos, built on hydōr plus aulos 'pipe': it means worked by water in a pipe or by liquid pressure, not by generating current.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 hydraulikos，由 hydōr 加 aulos「管」构成：指由管中水或液体压力驱动，不指发电。

entries.definition: Hydro- plus Greek -genes 'born': the 'water-former', named because burning it makes water; it is an element, not a power system.
entries.definitionCN: hydro- 加希腊 -genes「生成」：意为「生成水者」，因燃烧它会产生水而得名；它是一种元素，不是动力系统。

entries.definition: The base adjective for anything driven by or producing current; hydroelectric adds the source of that current.
entries.definitionCN: 指由电流驱动或产生电流的基础形容词；hydroelectric 补充了电流的来源。

entries.definition: Built on electron plus -ic: it describes circuits that control signals, not power generated from water.
entries.definitionCN: 由 electron 加 -ic 构成：描述控制信号的电路，而非水力发出的电力。

entries.definition: The noun for the power itself; hydroelectric is the adjective describing the plant or the process.
entries.definitionCN: 指动力本身的名称；hydroelectric 是描述电站或过程的形容词。

entries.definition: The everyday phrase for power from water, including old mills; it is broader and less technical.
entries.definitionCN: 指水力的日常说法，也包括老磨坊；范围更宽，技术性较弱。

entries.definition: Power from the rise and fall of tides rather than from a river's fall; the machinery is similar but the source differs.
entries.definitionCN: 来自潮涨潮落的动力，而非河流落差；机械相似，来源不同。

entries.definition: The wider class that includes water, wind, solar and biomass; hydroelectric is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的类别，包含水能、风能、太阳能与生物质能；水电是其中一员。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydro- 'water' + electric 'current-making': the adjective spells out its own recipe.
normal.cn: hydro-「水」+ electric「产生电流的」：这个形容词把自己的配方写在了字面上。

normal.en: The family runs hydroelectric, hydroelectricity, hydropower, hydraulic, hydrogen.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 hydroelectric、hydroelectricity、hydropower、hydraulic、hydrogen。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the plant: hydroelectric dam, hydroelectric plant, hydroelectric station.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出电站：水电站大坝、水力发电厂、水电站。

normal.en: Greek ēlektron 'amber' explains why electricity is named after a stone that crackles when rubbed.
normal.cn: 希腊 ēlektron「琥珀」解释了为什么电以一个摩擦会响的石头命名。

normal.en: Hydro- also appears in hydraulics, where water works through pipes instead of turning a generator.
normal.cn: hydro- 也出现在 hydraulics 中，那里的水通过管道做功，而不去转动发电机。

abstract.en: Picture a waterfall that has been taught to sing in wires.
abstract.cn: 想象一道瀑布学会了在电线里歌唱。

abstract.en: Picture a lake held above the valley like a raised hand waiting to push.
abstract.cn: 想象一片湖被举在河谷上方，像一只抬起待推的手。

abstract.en: Picture a hill that keeps a battery charged simply by being tall.
abstract.cn: 想象一座山，仅凭自己够高就为电池充着电。

examples.en: The country built its first hydroelectric plant in the mountains.
examples.cn: 这个国家在山区建起了第一座水力发电厂。

examples.en: Hydroelectric output falls when the reservoirs run low.
examples.cn: 水库水位过低时，水力发电量会下降。

examples.en: The map marks every hydroelectric dam on the river.
examples.cn: 地图标出了这条河上的每一座水电站大坝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「hydro（水）+ electric（电的）」——用水发出的电 → 水力发电的

root: 希腊 hydōr「水」（组合形式 hydro-）+ electric；electric 来自新拉丁 electricus「像琥珀的」，再上溯希腊 ēlektron「琥珀」。两个希腊成分拼成现代技术复合词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one machine: water falls, a gate opens, a turbine spins, a generator turns, current leaves, and the same adjective then classifies plants, names the product, labels an industry and finally carries a social charge.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一台机器展开：水落下、闸门开启、涡轮旋转、发电机转动、电流送出，随后同一形容词用来分类电站、命名产品、标注行业，最后带上社会情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a high dam holding a lake above a valley while water rushes through a gate into a machine hall.
core.cn: 核心意象：高坝把湖举在河谷上方，水流穿过闸门冲进机房。

branches.en: PHYSICAL CONVERSION: falling water drives a machine that changes hydraulic energy into current.
branches.cn: 物理转换：落水驱动机械，把水能变成电流。

branches.en: PLANT AND PRODUCT: the adjective classifies the dam and can also name the current it sells.
branches.cn: 电站与产品：形容词既分类大坝，也可指它所售的电流。

branches.en: INDUSTRY: engineering schools and construction firms turn the technique into a field.
branches.cn: 产业：工程院校与建设公司把这项技术变成一个领域。

branches.en: CLEAN AND GENERAL: climate accounting calls it clean, and the same shape stretches to any ready-made gradient.
branches.cn: 清洁与泛化：气候核算称其清洁，同一构造也延伸到任何现成落差。

branches.en: SOCIAL CHARGE: large dams flood valleys, so the word also stands for promise and protest.
branches.cn: 社会情绪：大型水坝淹没河谷，因此这个词也代表承诺与抗议。

intro.en: Hydroelectric is a modern compound of two Greek-derived elements. Each element is a combining form that still builds technical vocabulary, so the word can be read as 'water' plus 'current-making'.
intro.cn: hydroelectric 是两个希腊来源成分构成的现代复合词。每个成分都是仍在构成技术词汇的组合形式，因此这个词可读作「水」加「产生电流的」。

latinIntro.en: Latin electricus and electrum transmit the Greek amber word to English, while hydraulicus shows the same hydro- element in a different machine.

definition_en: electric power produced by converting the energy of falling or flowing water

senses.title: Electricity made from water
senses.definition: electric power generated when falling or flowing water drives a turbine and generator
senses.definitionCN: 落水或流水驱动涡轮与发电机时产生的电力
senses.example: The old mill now sells hydropower to the nearby town.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老磨坊如今向邻近城镇出售水电。
senses.why: hydro- names water and power names the rate of doing work, so the compound means work-rate delivered by water.
senses.whyCN: hydro- 指水，power 指做功的速率，因此复合词意为「由水交付的做功速率」。

senses.title: The resource and installed capacity
senses.definition: the water-power available at a site or already built into plants, counted in plans
senses.definitionCN: 某地可获得的水力，或已建成电站的能力，计入规划
senses.example: The province doubled its hydropower in a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 该省在十年内把水电装机容量翻了一倍。
senses.why: planners count a natural flow as a stock, so the word also names the capacity rather than only the current.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把自然流动当作存量，因此这个词也指容量，而不只是电流。

senses.title: Mechanical power from water
senses.definition: the turning force of a water wheel used directly for milling, pumping or lifting
senses.definitionCN: 水轮产生的转动力，直接用于磨粉、抽水或提升
senses.example: The museum's wheel produced hydropower for the loom.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的水轮为织机提供水力。
senses.why: the word predates electricity in spirit: power first meant mechanical force, and water supplied it long before generators.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在精神上早于电力：power 最初指机械力，而水在发电机出现之前早已提供它。

senses.title: A sector of the energy industry
senses.titleCN: 能源产业中的一个门类
senses.definition: the companies, contracts and regulations that build and run water-power stations
senses.definitionCN: 建造与运营水电站的公司、合同与法规
senses.example: Hydropower employs thousands of engineers in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 水电在该地区雇用数千名工程师。
senses.why: an energy source becomes an industry when it has its own firms, tariffs and trade bodies.
senses.whyCN: 当一种能源有了自己的公司、电价与行业协会，它就成为一个产业。

senses.title: A plant type with low storage
senses.titleCN: 一种少蓄水的电站类型
senses.definition: a station class, such as run-of-river, that uses the current flow without a large reservoir
senses.definitionCN: 一类电站，如径流式，利用当前流量而不建大型水库
senses.example: Run-of-river hydropower leaves the river's pace nearly unchanged.
senses.exampleCN: 径流式水电几乎不改变河流的流速。
senses.why: engineering divides the field by how water is held, and the word labels those divisions.
senses.whyCN: 工程学按蓄水方式划分领域，这个词就用来标注这些划分。

senses.title: Hydraulic power in physics
senses.definition: the power delivered by a fluid, calculated from flow rate and pressure or head
senses.definitionCN: 流体交付的功率，由流量与压力或水头算出
senses.example: The formula links hydropower to head and discharge.
senses.exampleCN: 该公式把水力功率与水头及流量联系起来。
senses.why: physics keeps power as a rate and replaces the river with two variables, head and discharge.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把 power 保留为速率，并把河流换成两个变量：水头与流量。

senses.title: The emblem of steady clean power
senses.titleCN: 稳定清洁电力的象征义
senses.definition: a symbol in debate for power that is both low-carbon and available on demand
senses.definitionCN: 讨论中象征既低碳又能按需调用的电力
senses.example: Hydropower became the anchor of the clean-energy plan.
senses.exampleCN: 水电成了这份清洁能源计划的锚。
senses.why: unlike sun and wind, a reservoir can be switched on, so the word stands for reliability as well as cleanliness.
senses.whyCN: 与太阳和风不同，水库可以随时开启，因此这个词既代表清洁也代表可靠。

senses.title: Power borrowed from an existing head
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：借既有落差取得的动力
senses.definition: any advantage converted into force because it already sits higher than its surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 因本就高于周边而被转化为力量的任何优势
senses.example: The firm treated its early patent as hydropower.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司把早期专利当作自己的水电。
senses.why: the metaphor needs only a height difference and a machine, so it fits reputations, patents and market position.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只需要高度差与一台机器，因此适用于声誉、专利与市场地位。

intro.en: Hydropower joins Greek hydro- 'water' with power, a noun that reached English through Old French from Latin posse 'to be able'. The compound is a nineteenth-century technical term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydropower 把希腊语 hydro-「水」与 power 组合起来；power 经古法语来自拉丁语 posse「能够」。这个复合词是 19 世纪的技术术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hydōr was the Greek noun for water. Its Indo-European source is a reconstruction, so the pre-Greek shape is not attested directly.
items.cn: hydōr 是希腊语中表示水的名词。其印欧语来源属于重构形式，因此希腊语之前的形态没有直接实证。

items.en: Hydro- became the standard combining form for water in science, from hydraulics to hydrosphere.
items.cn: hydro- 成为科学中表示水的标准组合形式，从 hydraulics 到 hydrosphere。

items.en: Posse 'to be able' was contracted from potis 'able' plus esse 'to be'; the origin of potis itself is not fully settled.
items.cn: posse「能够」由 potis「有能力的」加 esse「是」缩合而成；potis 本身的来源尚无定论。

items.en: Vulgar Latin potere reshaped posse, and Old French poeir passed the noun and verb into English as power and pouvoir's cousins.
items.cn: 通俗拉丁语 potere 重塑了 posse，古法语 poeir 把名词与动词传入英语，成为 power 及其同类。

items.en: Hydropower was coined in the nineteenth century, when water wheels were being fitted with generators and the output was sold as power.
items.cn: hydropower 于 19 世纪被造出，当时水轮开始装配发电机，产出作为电力出售。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Greek source of hydōr and the origin of potis are both unsettled, and the first printed use of the compound is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：hydōr 的希腊语之前来源与 potis 的来源都无定论，这个复合词的最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds words that share hydro- or power and are easily mistaken for this noun; group two holds other names for water-derived power.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 hydro- 或 power、容易被误当作本词的词；第二组是水能动力的其他名称。

entries.definition: The adjective describing a plant or process that makes current from water; hydropower is the noun for the power itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述用水发电的电站或过程的形容词；hydropower 是动力本身的名称。

entries.definition: The noun for the electricity specifically; it stresses the product, while hydropower can also stress capacity or mechanical force.
entries.definitionCN: 专指所发电流的名词；它强调产品，而 hydropower 也可强调容量或机械力。

entries.definition: A unit for measuring engine output, originally based on a horse's work; it measures power but says nothing about water.
entries.definitionCN: 计量发动机输出的单位，最初以马的工作量为基准；它测量功率，却与水源无关。

entries.definition: The facility where power is generated; a hydropower plant is one kind of power plant.
entries.definitionCN: 发电的场所；水电站是发电厂的一种。

entries.definition: The everyday term for power from water, including mills; it is broader and less technical than hydropower.
entries.definitionCN: 指水力的日常说法，包括磨坊；比 hydropower 更宽泛、技术性更弱。

entries.definition: Power from tides rather than from a river's fall; the turbines are similar but the driving cycle is the moon.
entries.definitionCN: 来自潮汐而非河流落差的动力；涡轮相似，但驱动周期来自月亮。

entries.definition: A hydropower method that pumps water uphill when power is cheap and lets it fall when demand is high.
entries.definitionCN: 一种水电方式：电力便宜时把水抽上山，需求高时再让其落下。

entries.definition: The wider class that includes water, wind, solar and biomass; hydropower is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的类别，包含水能、风能、太阳能与生物质能；水电是其中一员。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydro- 'water' + power 'work-rate': the compound literally names the rate at which water does work.
normal.cn: hydro-「水」+ power「做功速率」：复合词字面就是水做功的速率。

normal.en: The family runs hydropower, hydroelectric, hydroelectricity, hydraulic, hydrosphere.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 hydropower、hydroelectric、hydroelectricity、hydraulic、hydrosphere。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the plant: hydropower station, hydropower plant, hydropower capacity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出电站：水电站、水力发电厂、水电装机容量。

normal.en: Latin posse 'to be able' is the ancestor of power, so power is literally ability.
normal.cn: 拉丁 posse「能够」是 power 的祖先，所以 power 字面上就是能力。

normal.en: Run-of-river hydropower is the term for a station that does not hold a large reservoir.
normal.cn: 径流式水电指不建大型水库的电站，这是该词在工程中的固定用法。

abstract.en: Picture a river that works a night shift without asking for wages.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河上夜班，却从不讨工钱。

abstract.en: Picture a reservoir as a bank where the currency is height.
abstract.cn: 想象一座水库是银行，里面的货币是高度。

abstract.en: Picture a hill that lends its slope to every machine below.
abstract.cn: 想象一座山把自己的坡度借给下方每一台机器。

examples.cn: 水电供应了这个国家的大部分电力。

examples.en: Drought reduced hydropower output for two summers.
examples.cn: 干旱使两个夏季的水电出力下降。

examples.en: The village replaced its diesel generator with hydropower.
examples.cn: 这个村庄用水电取代了柴油发电机。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one drop: water is held, falls, spins a turbine, drives a generator, leaves as current, and the same word then names capacity, mechanical force, a sector, a plant type, a physical rate, a clean emblem and a borrowed advantage.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次落水展开：水被蓄起、落下、转动涡轮、带动发电机、以电流送出，随后同一词用来命名容量、机械力、产业、电站类型、物理速率、清洁象征与借来的优势。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river led into a machine hall where falling water keeps a turbine spinning.
core.cn: 核心意象：河水被引进机房，落下的水让涡轮持续旋转。

branches.en: PHYSICAL RATE: falling water delivers power, whether measured at the meter or in a formula.
branches.cn: 物理速率：落水交付功率，无论是在电表上测量还是在公式里计算。

branches.en: STOCK AND SHAFT: the same word names installed capacity and the direct turning of an old wheel.
branches.cn: 存量与转轴：同一词既指装机容量，也指老水轮的直接转动。

branches.en: SECTOR AND PLANT TYPE: firms and regulations form an industry, and engineering divides it by how water is held.
branches.cn: 产业与电站类型：公司与法规构成行业，工程学再按蓄水方式划分。

branches.en: CLEAN AND STEADY: a reservoir can be switched on, so the word stands for reliable clean power.
branches.cn: 清洁且稳定：水库可以随时开启，因此这个词代表可靠的清洁电力。

branches.en: BORROWED HEIGHT: any existing advantage can act as the head that drives a machine.
branches.cn: 借来的高度：任何既有优势都可充当驱动机械的水头。

intro.en: Hydropower is a compound of a Greek combining form and a Latin-derived noun. Both halves are common word-forming elements, so the word can be read as 'water' plus 'work-rate'.
intro.cn: hydropower 是希腊组合形式与拉丁来源名词的复合。两半都是常见的构词成分，因此这个词可读作「水」加「做功速率」。

latinIntro.en: Latin posse and potentia supply power, powerful, powerless and empower; Greek hydōr supplies hydro- and hydraulics.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 posse 与 potentia 衍生 power、powerful、powerless 与 empower；希腊 hydōr 衍生 hydro- 与 hydraulics。

definition_zh: 可持续发展；既满足当代需要又不损害后代满足其需要能力的发展
definition_en: development that meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs
core_image: 一座城市在生长，同时老树林与河岸被原样保留，新旧并排
scene: 新建的街区旁边保留着老树林与河岸，工地与绿地在同一张图上并存。 The city adopted a sustainable development plan for the riverfront.
sceneCN: 这里 sustainable development 指「兼顾当代与后代需求的发展方式」（第 1 个义项：既满足当前需要，又不削弱后代满足其需要的能力）；句意为这座城市为滨河地区通过了可持续发展规划。图中可辨识物件：新楼、保留的老树、河岸步道、铺开的规划图。

pos.zh: 可持续发展（不可数固定短语）

collocations.zh: 为可持续发展提供资金

senses.title: Meeting present needs without harming the future
senses.titleCN: 满足当代而不损害后代
senses.definition: development that satisfies current needs while leaving later generations the same ability to satisfy theirs
senses.definitionCN: 在满足当前需要的同时，让后代保有同样的满足其需要的能力
senses.example: The city adopted a sustainable development plan for the riverfront.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市为滨河地区通过了可持续发展规划。
senses.why: sustainable says the process can be kept up, and development says it grows; together they demand growth that does not consume its own support.
senses.whyCN: sustainable 表示过程能维持下去，development 表示它在生长；两者合起来要求增长不消耗自身的支撑条件。

senses.title: A policy framework and its goals
senses.definition: the international framework of goals, targets and reports built around that principle
senses.definitionCN: 围绕这一原则建立的国际目标、指标与报告体系
senses.example: The country reported progress against the sustainable development goals.
senses.exampleCN: 该国报告了在可持续发展目标上的进展。
senses.why: a principle becomes a policy when it is written into goals with numbers and deadlines.
senses.whyCN: 当原则被写成带数字与期限的目标，它就成为政策。

senses.title: Managing resources so they renew
senses.titleCN: 以可再生方式管理资源
senses.definition: the practice of using soil, water, forests and fish no faster than they can renew
senses.definitionCN: 使用土壤、水、森林与鱼类时不超过其再生速度的做法
senses.example: Forestry schools teach sustainable development through rotation cycles.
senses.exampleCN: 林业学校通过轮伐周期讲授可持续发展。
senses.why: the oldest use of sustainable is about keeping a yield going, so resource management is its natural home.
senses.whyCN: sustainable 最古老的用法就是让产量延续，因此资源管理是它最自然的归属。

senses.title: Growth decoupled from damage
senses.titleCN: 与损害脱钩的增长模式
senses.definition: an economic model in which output rises while resource use and pollution fall
senses.definitionCN: 产出上升而资源使用与污染下降的经济模式
senses.example: The report measured sustainable development as growth per tonne of carbon.
senses.exampleCN: 报告用每吨碳对应的增长来衡量可持续发展。
senses.why: economists keep development as growth but attach a condition: the growth must not raise its material cost.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家保留 development 的增长含义，但附加条件：增长不得抬高其物质代价。

senses.title: A planning principle for places
senses.definition: a rule for designing towns and regions so that transport, housing and green space last
senses.definitionCN: 设计城镇与区域时使交通、住房与绿地都能持久运作的规则
senses.example: The riverfront plan applies sustainable development block by block.
senses.exampleCN: 滨河规划逐街区地应用可持续发展原则。
senses.why: planners turn the principle into setbacks, density limits and preserved corridors.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把原则变成退线、密度上限与保留廊道。

senses.title: A corporate strategy label
senses.definition: the label companies use for environmental and social targets in their reporting
senses.definitionCN: 公司在报告中用于环境与社会目标的标签
senses.example: The firm folded sustainable development into its annual report.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司把可持续发展并入年度报告。
senses.why: when investors ask for non-financial performance, the phrase becomes a heading in corporate disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 当投资者要求非财务绩效，这个短语就成了企业披露中的一个标题。

senses.title: Any practice that keeps a system going
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：使系统得以延续的做法
senses.definition: any arrangement that lets a system continue without exhausting what supports it
senses.definitionCN: 任何使系统在不耗尽支撑条件的情况下继续运转的安排
senses.example: The coach called rotation sustainable development for the squad.
senses.exampleCN: 教练把轮换称作球队的可持续发展。
senses.why: the phrase keeps only its logical shape, so it can describe a team, a diet or a budget.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语只保留其逻辑形态，因此可描述球队、饮食或预算。

senses.title: A slogan open to greenwashing
senses.definition: the phrase used as a slogan whose record may not match its promise
senses.definitionCN: 被当作标语使用、实际记录却可能与承诺不符的说法
senses.example: Critics called the advertisement sustainable development in name only.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者称这则广告只是名义上的可持续发展。
senses.why: a phrase broad enough to sell anything invites the charge that it means nothing.
senses.whyCN: 一个宽到可以推销任何东西的短语，难免被指为空话。

intro.en: Sustainable development joins Latin sustinere 'to hold up' with Old French desveloper 'to unwrap'. The fixed phrase became prominent through the 1987 Brundtland Report. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: sustainable development 把拉丁 sustinere「从下面托住」与古法语 desveloper「解开包裹」并置。这个固定短语经 1987 年布伦特兰报告而广为人知。年代均为约数。

items.en: Sub- 'up from below' plus tenere 'to hold' produced sustinere 'to hold up, maintain, endure'. The image is a hand under a weight.
items.cn: sub-「从下往上」加 tenere「握住」构成 sustinere「托住、维持、承受」。意象是一只手在重物下方支撑。

items.en: Old French sustenir carried the verb into English as sustain in the thirteenth century, first for holding up a thing or a claim.
items.cn: 古法语 sustenir 在 13 世纪把这个动词带入英语，成为 sustain，最初指托住物体或支撑主张。

items.en: Desveloper meant 'to unwrap, unfurl', from des- 'undo' plus a second element of uncertain origin, perhaps Germanic.
items.cn: desveloper 意为「解开、展开」，由 des-「去除」加一个来源不确定的成分构成，该成分可能来自日耳曼语。

items.en: English development first meant an unfolding or a gradual revelation, and only later the growth of towns, economies and capabilities.
items.cn: 英语 development 最初指展开或逐渐显现，后来才指城镇、经济与能力的增长。

items.en: The 1987 report Our Common Future fixed the modern definition, and the phrase then spread into treaties, curricula and corporate reports.
items.cn: 1987 年的《我们共同的未来》固定了现代定义，这个短语随后进入条约、课程与企业报告。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and second element): earlier isolated uses exist, the exact first appearance is not fixed, and the origin of the desveloper element is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与第二成分）：更早的零星用例存在，确切首见时间没有定说，desveloper 第二成分的来源亦无定论。

note.en: Group one holds forms that share sustain or develop and are easily confused; group two holds neighbouring policy ideas with a different emphasis.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 sustain 或 develop、容易混淆的形式；第二组是侧重点不同的邻近政策概念。

entries.definition: The past participle meaning 'continued for a long time', as in sustained growth; it describes duration, not the ability to continue.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词，意为「持续了很长时间的」，如持续增长；它描述持续时间，不描述延续能力。

entries.definition: Able to be kept going over time; it is the first element of the phrase and can stand alone.
entries.definitionCN: 能够长期维持的；它是短语的第一个成分，也可单独使用。

entries.definition: From the same Latin verb: that which holds a person up, usually food or livelihood.
entries.definitionCN: 同出这一拉丁动词：支撑人的东西，通常指食物或生计。

entries.definition: The noun for growth or unfolding; on its own it carries no promise of restraint.
entries.definitionCN: 表示增长或展开的名词；单独使用时并不包含克制的承诺。

entries.definition: Growth that can continue without collapse; it stresses output rather than the needs of future generations.
entries.definitionCN: 能够不崩溃地持续的增长；它强调产出，而非后代的需求。

entries.definition: A policy label that stresses low pollution and low carbon, often without the full intergenerational definition.
entries.definitionCN: 强调低污染与低碳的政策标签，通常不含完整的代际定义。

entries.definition: A model that keeps materials in use by reuse and repair; it is one way to pursue sustainable development.
entries.definitionCN: 通过再利用与修复让材料持续使用的模式；它是实现可持续发展的一种方式。

entries.definition: Protecting nature as such; sustainable development also includes economic and social goals.
entries.definitionCN: 保护自然本身；可持续发展还包含经济与社会目标。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: sustinere 'hold up' + desveloper 'unwrap': keep the support under the growth.
normal.cn: sustinere「托住」+ desveloper「展开」：在增长下方一直托着支撑。

normal.en: The family runs sustain, sustainable, sustainability, sustainably, unsustainable.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 sustain、sustainable、sustainability、sustainably、unsustainable。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the policy sense: sustainable development goals, strategy, indicators.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出政策义：可持续发展目标、战略、指标。

normal.en: The Latin image is a hand under a weight: support, not speed.
normal.cn: 拉丁意象是一只手托着重物：讲的是支撑，不是速度。

normal.en: The 1987 Brundtland definition is the one quoted in treaties: present needs without harming future ability.
normal.cn: 条约常引的是 1987 年布伦特兰定义：满足当代而不损害后代的能力。

abstract.en: Picture a ladder that repairs its own rungs as you climb.
abstract.cn: 想象一架梯子，你往上爬时它自己修补横档。

abstract.en: Picture a budget that pays today's bills and leaves tomorrow's intact.
abstract.cn: 想象一份预算，付清今天的账，又不动明天的钱。

abstract.en: Picture a tree whose shade is used without cutting the trunk.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树，人们用它的树荫，却不砍它的树干。

examples.en: The syllabus treats sustainable development as an economic issue too.
examples.cn: 这份教学大纲把可持续发展也当作经济问题。

examples.en: Fishing quotas are a test of sustainable development in practice.
examples.cn: 捕鱼配额是可持续发展在实践中的一次检验。

examples.en: The bank refused to fund the mine on sustainable development grounds.
examples.cn: 银行以可持续发展为由拒绝为这座矿提供资金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「sustainable（能撑住的）+ development（发展）」——能一直撑下去的发展 → 可持续发展

root: sustain 来自拉丁 sustinere「托住、维持」= sub-「从下」+ tenere「握住」；develop 经古法语 desveloper「解开包裹」，其第二成分来源不确定；development 的「发展」义为后起。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one condition: a process must keep its own support intact. That condition is then applied to international goals, resource management, growth models, town plans, corporate reports, any continuing system, and finally to the phrase used as an empty slogan.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个条件展开：过程必须保持自身支撑完好。这个条件随后用于国际目标、资源管理、增长模式、城镇规划、企业报告、任何延续中的系统，最后用于被当作空口号的短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a growing town that keeps its old trees and riverbank standing beside the new blocks.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座生长的城镇，让老树与河岸立在新街区旁边。

branches.en: THE CORE CONDITION: present need is met, and future ability is left whole.
branches.cn: 核心条件：当代需要得到满足，后代能力保持完整。

branches.en: GOALS AND RENEWAL: the principle is written into targets and into harvest rates that let a stock renew.
branches.cn: 目标与再生：原则被写进指标，也写进让存量再生的采获速率。

branches.en: GROWTH AND REPORTING: economists decouple output from damage, and firms adopt the label for disclosure.
branches.cn: 增长与披露：经济学家让产出与损害脱钩，企业采用这一标签作披露。

branches.en: PLANNING: the rule becomes setbacks, density limits and preserved corridors.
branches.cn: 规划：规则变成退线、密度上限与保留廊道。

branches.en: GENERALIZED AND EMPTY: any system can be kept going, and any slogan can abuse the phrase.
branches.cn: 泛化与空化：任何系统都可维持，任何口号都可滥用这个短语。

intro.en: Sustainable development is a phrase of two learned nouns: an adjective built on a Latin verb and a noun built on a French verb. Both halves are still productive, so the phrase can be read piece by piece.
intro.cn: sustainable development 是两个学术名词构成的短语：一个由拉丁动词构成的形容词，加一个由法语动词构成的名词。两半都仍有构词能力，因此这个短语可以逐块读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' gives sustain, sustenance and tenant; Latin sub- gives the upward support. The develop element is French and its second part is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tenere「握住」衍生 sustain、sustenance 与 tenant；拉丁 sub- 提供向上支撑义。develop 成分来自法语，其第二部分来源不确定。

items.structure: Latin prefix sub- 'under, up from below'
items.example: The prefix puts the support beneath the load.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把支撑放在重物之下。

items.example: The root supplies the idea of holding firm.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「稳稳握住」的意思。

items.structure: Latin sustinere via Old French sustenir
items.example: The soil sustains the crop for one season.
items.exampleCN: 土壤维持一季作物。

items.example: A yield that can be sustained is sustainable.
items.exampleCN: 能维持下去的产量就是可持续的。

items.example: The farm uses sustainable methods.
items.exampleCN: 这个农场采用可持续的方法。

items.example: Sustainability is the state of being able to continue.
items.exampleCN: sustainability 就是能够延续的状态。

items.example: The audit measured sustainability of the harvest.
items.exampleCN: 审计衡量了采获的可持续性。

items.example: The town developed along the river.
items.exampleCN: 这座城镇沿河发展起来。

items.example: The city adopted a sustainable development plan.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市通过了可持续发展规划。

items.example: The water use was unsustainable.
items.exampleCN: 这种用水方式不可持续。

definition_zh: 生态足迹；维持某一人群或活动所需的生物生产性土地与水域面积
definition_en: the area of productive land and water needed to supply a population's resources and absorb its wastes
core_image: 沙地上留下一个清晰脚印，旁边并排展开草地、农田、水域与林地的面积刻度
scene: 沙地上留下一个清晰脚印，旁边并排画出草地、农田、水域与林地的面积。 The report measured the ecological footprint of the whole city.
sceneCN: 这里 ecological footprint 指「维持某群体所需的生产性土地与水域面积」（第 1 个义项：把资源消耗与废物吸收折算成土地面积）；句意为报告测量了整座城市的生态足迹。图中可辨识物件：脚印、田块、水域、林地边界。

pos.zh: 生态足迹（可数；复数 ecological footprints）

senses.title: The land area a population requires
senses.titleCN: 某群体所需的土地面积
senses.definition: the productive land and water area required to supply a group's resources and absorb its waste
senses.definitionCN: 为一个群体提供资源并吸收其废物所需的生产性土地与水域面积
senses.example: The report measured the ecological footprint of the whole city.
senses.exampleCN: 报告测量了整座城市的生态足迹。
senses.why: footprint names the mark left by standing on land, and ecological names the living system; together they say how much land a way of life occupies.
senses.whyCN: footprint 指踩在土地上留下的印记，ecological 指生命系统；合起来表示一种生活方式占用了多少土地。

senses.title: A per-capita or national indicator
senses.titleCN: 人均或国家层面的指标
senses.definition: the figure expressed per person or per country for comparison across populations
senses.definitionCN: 按人均或按国家表达的数值，用于比较不同人群
senses.example: The atlas lists the ecological footprint of every nation.
senses.exampleCN: 这本图集列出了每个国家的生态足迹。
senses.why: an area becomes an indicator once it is divided by population and put into a table.
senses.whyCN: 当面积被人口相除并放进表格，它就变成了指标。

senses.title: The carbon component
senses.definition: the share of the footprint that represents land needed to absorb carbon dioxide
senses.definitionCN: 足迹中代表吸收二氧化碳所需土地的那一部分
senses.example: Flying added a large block to her ecological footprint.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行给她的生态足迹增加了一大块。
senses.why: waste absorption needs land too, and carbon is the waste that dominates modern accounts.
senses.whyCN: 吸收废物同样需要土地，而碳是现代核算中占主导的废物。

senses.title: A formal accounting method
senses.definition: the method that converts consumption and waste into global hectares for comparison
senses.definitionCN: 把消费与废物折算成全球公顷以便比较的方法
senses.example: The course teaches ecological footprint accounting step by step.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课逐步讲授生态足迹核算。
senses.why: once the idea is given a unit and a procedure, the phrase also names the method rather than only the result.
senses.whyCN: 当这个想法有了单位与程序，短语也就指方法，而不只是结果。

senses.title: A corporate or product label
senses.definition: the footprint attributed to a firm, a supply chain or a single product
senses.definitionCN: 归属于某公司、供应链或单一产品的足迹
senses.example: The label printed the ecological footprint of the shirt.
senses.exampleCN: 标签上印着这件衬衫的生态足迹。
senses.why: firms shrink the population to a product so that buyers can compare one purchase with another.
senses.whyCN: 企业把群体缩小为一件产品，好让购买者比较不同商品。

senses.title: An urban planning metric
senses.definition: a measure used to test whether a district's land use fits within its region
senses.definitionCN: 用来检验某街区土地利用是否落在本区域承载范围内的量度
senses.example: Planners compared the district's ecological footprint with its hinterland.
senses.exampleCN: 规划者把该街区的生态足迹与其腹地作比较。
senses.why: cities import their land use from elsewhere, so the metric makes that hidden dependence visible.
senses.whyCN: 城市从别处输入土地利用，这个指标让这种隐藏的依赖变得可见。

senses.title: The sign of planetary overshoot
senses.definition: a symbol for demand exceeding the planet's regenerative capacity
senses.definitionCN: 象征需求超过地球再生能力的标志
senses.example: Earth overshoot day is the ecological footprint made into a calendar date.
senses.exampleCN: 地球超载日就是把生态足迹变成日历上的一个日期。
senses.why: when footprints are added up, they can be compared with the total land available, and the gap reads as overshoot.
senses.whyCN: 把足迹相加后，可与可用土地总量比较，差额就被读作超载。

senses.title: Any trace left on a system
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：留在系统上的任何痕迹
senses.definition: the total disturbance any activity leaves on a system that must absorb it
senses.definitionCN: 任何活动在一个必须吸收它的系统上留下的总扰动
senses.example: The studio measured its ecological footprint in server hours.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室用服务器小时来衡量自己的生态足迹。
senses.why: the metaphor survives wherever an activity draws on a finite pool and returns a residue.
senses.whyCN: 只要一项活动取用有限资源并留下残余，这个比喻就成立。

intro.en: Ecological footprint joins Greek oikos 'house' and -logia 'study' to the native English words foot and print. The phrase was coined at the end of the twentieth century as an accounting tool. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ecological footprint 把希腊 oikos「家」与 -logia「研究」接到英语本族的 foot 与 print 上。这个短语在 20 世纪末作为一种核算工具被造出。年代均为约数。

items.en: Oikos meant 'house, household, family property'. Ecology later took it as the root for the whole household of nature.
items.cn: oikos 意为「房屋、家庭、家产」。生态学后来把它当作整个自然之家的词根。

items.en: -Logia 'study of' comes from logos 'word, reason, account'. Ecology was coined in 1866 as the study of the household of nature.
items.cn: -logia「…研究」来自 logos「言词、理性、账目」。ecology 于 1866 年被造出，指研究自然之家的学问。

items.en: Fot 'foot' is a native Germanic word. Print came through Old French preinte from Latin premere 'to press'.
items.cn: fot「脚」是日耳曼本族词。print 经古法语 preinte 来自拉丁 premere「压」。

items.en: Footprint first meant the mark of a foot on ground or snow; the extended sense of the area something occupies is much later.
items.cn: footprint 最初指脚在地面或雪上留下的印子；表示某物占用面积的引申义出现得晚得多。

items.en: Ecological footprint was coined in the early 1990s as a way to express resource demand in hectares of land.
items.cn: ecological footprint 于 1990 年代初被造出，用土地公顷来表达资源需求。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Greek origin of oikos is unsettled, and the exact first printed use of the phrase is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：oikos 在希腊语之前的来源无定论，这个短语确切的最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds footprint compounds that are often substituted for this phrase; group two holds the accounting concepts it is compared with.
note.cn: 第一组是常被用来替换本短语的 footprint 复合词；第二组是与之相比较的核算概念。

entries.definition: The part of the account that covers greenhouse gases only; the ecological footprint also counts food, fibre and built land.
entries.definitionCN: 只覆盖温室气体的那一部分；生态足迹还计入食物、纤维与建设用地。

entries.definition: The volume of fresh water used by a product or group, measured in litres rather than hectares.
entries.definitionCN: 产品或群体使用的淡水量，以升而非公顷计量。

entries.definition: A broad label for any environmental impact, often without the strict land-area method.
entries.definitionCN: 对任何环境影响的宽泛标签，通常不含严格的土地面积算法。

entries.definition: The mark of a foot; used alone it can also mean the physical space a machine occupies.
entries.definitionCN: 脚留下的印子；单独使用时也可指机器占用的物理空间。

entries.tag: the other side of the ratio
entries.definition: The land's ability to supply resources and absorb waste; the footprint is demand against this supply.
entries.definitionCN: 土地提供资源并吸收废物的能力；足迹是相对这一供给的需求。

entries.definition: The maximum population an area can support; it is a limit, while the footprint is a measured demand.
entries.definitionCN: 某区域能支撑的最大种群；它是上限，而足迹是测得的需求。

entries.definition: The amount by which demand passes capacity; the footprint is the measure that reveals it.
entries.definitionCN: 需求超出承载力的部分；足迹是揭示它的量度。

entries.definition: The state of living within capacity; the footprint is one tool for testing whether that state is reached.
entries.definitionCN: 在承载范围内生活的状态；足迹是检验是否达到该状态的一种工具。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: oikos 'house' + logos 'account': ecology is the accounting of nature's household.
normal.cn: oikos「家」+ logos「账目」：生态学就是对自然之家的记账。

normal.en: foot + print: the phrase asks how much ground a lifestyle stands on.
normal.cn: foot + print：这个短语问的是一种生活方式占了多少地。

normal.en: The family runs ecology, ecological, ecologist, footprint, environmental footprint.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 ecology、ecological、ecologist、footprint、environmental footprint。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the method: ecological footprint analysis, per capita ecological footprint.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出方法：生态足迹分析、人均生态足迹。

normal.en: Biocapacity is the supply side; the footprint is the demand side of the same ledger.
normal.cn: 生物承载力是供给方，生态足迹是同一账本的需求方。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint so large that the ground beneath it must be imported.
abstract.cn: 想象一个脚印大到它脚下的土地必须靠进口。

abstract.en: Picture a household whose rubbish pile is taller than its garden.
abstract.cn: 想象一户人家，垃圾堆比自家花园还高。

abstract.en: Picture a receipt that lists land instead of money.
abstract.cn: 想象一张小票，上面列的是土地而不是钱。

examples.en: Beef raises a household's ecological footprint more than beans do.
examples.cn: 牛肉比豆类更能抬高一个家庭的生态足迹。

examples.en: The class calculated its ecological footprint from food and travel data.
examples.cn: 全班根据饮食与出行数据计算了自己的生态足迹。

examples.en: A city's ecological footprint often exceeds its own borders.
examples.cn: 一座城市的生态足迹常常超出它自己的边界。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ecological（生态的）+ footprint（脚印）」——生活方式在地球上踩出的脚印 → 生态足迹

root: 希腊 oikos「家」+ -logia「研究」（来自 logos「账目、理性」）构成 ecology/ecological；footprint 为英语本族 foot 加经古法语来自拉丁 premere「压」的 print。整个短语是 20 世纪末的核算造词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one ledger: resources are taken, waste is returned, both are converted into land area, and that area is then read per person, split into carbon, turned into a method, attached to products, mapped onto cities, summed into overshoot and finally borrowed as a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一本账展开：取用资源、排出废物、两者折算为土地面积，随后这个面积按人均读出、拆出碳部分、变成方法、贴到产品上、映射到城市、汇总为超载，最后被借作比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a footprint beside a measured patch of field, water and forest.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个脚印旁边是被丈量过的农田、水域与林地。

branches.en: LAND ACCOUNTING: the base measure is the area a group or district needs, wherever that land lies.
branches.cn: 土地核算：基本量度是一个群体或街区所需的面积，无论那片土地在哪里。

branches.en: INDICATOR AND CARBON: the area is divided per person, and one block of it is carbon absorption.
branches.cn: 指标与碳：面积按人均相除，其中一块是碳吸收。

branches.en: METHOD AND LABEL: the procedure becomes a formal analysis and is then printed on products.
branches.cn: 方法与标签：程序成为正式分析，随后印到产品上。

branches.en: OVERSHOOT: total demand compared with total capacity produces the calendar symbol of Earth overshoot day.
branches.cn: 超载：总需求与总承载力相比，产生地球超载日这一日历象征。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any activity that draws on a finite pool and leaves a residue can be given a footprint.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何取用有限资源并留下残余的活动都可以被赋予足迹。

intro.en: Ecological footprint is a hybrid phrase: Greek elements form the adjective, native Germanic and French elements form the noun. Each part remains productive in modern English.
intro.cn: ecological footprint 是一个混合短语：希腊成分构成形容词，日耳曼本族成分与法语成分构成名词。每一部分在现代英语中仍有构词能力。

latinIntro.en: Neo-Latin oecologia transmits the Greek oikos to English; Latin premere 'to press' gives print, imprint and impress.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁 oecologia 把希腊 oikos 传给英语；拉丁 premere「压」衍生 print、imprint 与 impress。

items.structure: Greek oikos 'house' used as a combining form
items.example: Ecotourism protects the local habitat.
items.exampleCN: 生态旅游保护当地生境。

items.example: The root names nature as one household.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把自然命名为一户人家。

items.example: Ecology is the study of the natural household.
items.exampleCN: 生态学是研究自然之家的学问。

items.meaning: the study of organisms and their surroundings
items.example: Ecology links the marsh to the river.
items.exampleCN: 生态学把沼泽与河流联系起来。

items.example: The ecological cost was high.
items.exampleCN: 生态代价很高。

items.meaning: the body part, or its mark
items.example: A foot pressed into wet sand.
items.exampleCN: 一只脚压进湿沙。

items.structure: Old French preinte < Latin premere 'to press'
items.example: The print kept the shape of the sole.
items.exampleCN: 印记保留了鞋底的形状。

items.meaning: the mark of a foot; the space occupied
items.example: The machine has a small footprint.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器占地很小。

items.meaning: the land area a population needs
items.example: The report measured the ecological footprint of the whole city.
items.exampleCN: 报告测量了整座城市的生态足迹。

latinEntries.structure: oecologia, -ae (f., first declension; Neo-Latin from Greek oikos + -logia)
latinEntries.meaning: the study of the household of nature
latinEntries.meaningCN: 研究自然之家的学问；生态学

definition_en: the using up of a natural resource faster than it can be replaced
core_image: 一座原本满溢的仓库逐渐见底，货架上只剩空框
scene: 采空的矿坑边缘堆着废弃设备，原本厚实的矿层只剩薄薄一层。 Years of logging led to resource depletion in the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 resource depletion 指「资源被消耗到所剩无几的状态或过程」（第 1 个义项：可再生或不可再生资源被取用的速度超过补充速度）；句意为多年伐木导致这个山谷的资源枯竭。图中可辨识物件：空矿坑、废弃设备、薄矿层、被砍光的坡地。

pos.zh: 资源枯竭；资源耗竭（不可数）

senses.title: Taking a resource faster than it renews
senses.titleCN: 取用速度快于补充速度
senses.definition: the process of drawing on a natural resource faster than natural processes replace it
senses.definitionCN: 取用自然资源的速度超过自然过程补充它的速度
senses.example: Years of logging led to resource depletion in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 多年伐木导致这个山谷的资源枯竭。
senses.why: resource names a stock that can be drawn on, and depletion is Latin for emptying out, so the phrase describes a stock being emptied.
senses.whyCN: resource 指可供取用的存量，depletion 是拉丁语「倒空」，因此短语描述存量被倒空。

senses.title: The scarce state reached
senses.definition: the condition in which little of the resource remains available
senses.definitionCN: 资源所剩无几的状态
senses.example: The town faced resource depletion after the wells failed.
senses.exampleCN: 水井干涸后，这座城镇面临资源枯竭。
senses.why: the same phrase can name the process or its end state, so it works both as a verb-like and an adjective-like description.
senses.whyCN: 同一短语既可指过程，也可指终态，因此兼具动词性与形容词性的描述功能。

senses.title: Mining an aquifer
senses.definition: the falling of groundwater levels because pumping exceeds recharge
senses.definitionCN: 抽水量超过补给量导致地下水位下降
senses.example: Wetland drainage caused groundwater resource depletion.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地排水造成地下水资源枯竭。
senses.why: groundwater behaves like a bank account with a slow deposit rate, so pumping is literally withdrawal.
senses.whyCN: 地下水像一个存入很慢的账户，抽水就是字面上的取款。

senses.title: Overharvesting renewable stocks
senses.titleCN: 可再生资源的过度采获
senses.definition: the decline of fish, game or timber when harvest exceeds regrowth
senses.definitionCN: 捕捞或采伐超过再生量时鱼类、猎物或木材的下降
senses.example: The fishery collapsed through resource depletion.
senses.exampleCN: 这片渔场因资源枯竭而崩溃。
senses.why: even a resource that renews can be emptied if the rate of taking outruns the rate of return.
senses.whyCN: 即使是可再生资源，只要取用速率超过回补速率，也会被掏空。

senses.title: Exhausting finite minerals and fuels
senses.titleCN: 耗尽有限的矿产与燃料
senses.definition: the permanent loss of coal, oil or ore deposits that cannot be replaced within human time
senses.definitionCN: 煤、石油或矿藏在人类时间尺度内无法补充的永久减少
senses.example: The report warned of resource depletion in the oil fields.
senses.exampleCN: 报告警告油田存在资源枯竭。
senses.why: for a finite stock, depletion is not a cycle but a one-way countdown.
senses.whyCN: 对有限存量而言，耗竭不是循环，而是单向倒计时。

senses.title: Natural capital in national accounts
senses.titleCN: 国民账户中的自然资本
senses.definition: the decrease in the value of natural capital recorded in economic accounting
senses.definitionCN: 经济核算中记录的自然资本价值下降
senses.example: The treasury booked resource depletion as a loss of national wealth.
senses.exampleCN: 财政部把资源耗竭记为国家财富的损失。
senses.why: economists treat a mine or a forest as capital, so taking it out is depreciation under another name.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家把矿或森林当作资本，取出来就是换了名字的折旧。

senses.title: A strategic alarm
senses.definition: the phrase used in politics and security talk to warn of dependence on scarce supplies
senses.definitionCN: 政治与安全话语中用来警告依赖稀缺供给的说法
senses.example: Resource depletion shaped the country's foreign policy.
senses.exampleCN: 资源枯竭塑造了这个国家的外交政策。
senses.why: when a supply is also a strategic input, emptying it becomes a security question rather than only an environmental one.
senses.whyCN: 当一种供给同时也是战略投入，掏空它就成了安全问题，而不只是环境问题。

senses.title: Draining any shared pool
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何共享储备被抽干
senses.definition: the exhaustion of any shared pool, such as attention, trust or talent
senses.definitionCN: 任何共享储备的耗尽，如注意力、信任或人才
senses.example: Constant meetings caused resource depletion in the team's energy.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的会议造成团队精力的资源枯竭。
senses.why: the metaphor needs only a common stock and too many withdrawals, which is why it fits organisations as well as aquifers.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只需一个公共存量与过多的抽取，因此既适用于含水层，也适用于组织。

intro.en: Resource depletion joins resource, from Old French ressource 'a new springing up', with depletion, from Latin deplere 'to empty out'. The modern environmental phrase is recent. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: resource depletion 把 resource（来自古法语 ressource「重新涌出」）与 depletion（来自拉丁 deplere「倒空」）组合起来。现代的环保短语出现较晚。年代均为约数。

items.en: Re- 'again' plus surgere 'to rise' produced resurgere 'to rise again', the source of the idea of a supply that springs back.
items.cn: re-「再次」加 surgere「升起」构成 resurgere「再起」，这是「供给会重新涌出」这一观念的来源。

items.en: Ressource first meant 'a means of recovery, recourse'; the sense of a stock or supply developed later in English.
items.cn: ressource 最初意为「恢复的手段、求助对象」；「储备、资源」义在英语中较晚才发展出来。

items.en: De- 'completely' plus plere 'to fill' gave deplere 'to empty out', literally to un-fill a container.
items.cn: de-「完全」加 plere「装满」构成 deplere「倒空」，字面上就是把容器里的东西卸掉。

items.en: English depletion first described emptying the body of fluids in medicine, then any exhausting of a stock.
items.cn: 英语 depletion 最初在医学中描述排出体液，后来指任何存量的耗尽。

items.en: Resource depletion became a fixed environmental phrase in the twentieth century with the conservation and limits-to-growth debates.
items.cn: resource depletion 在 20 世纪随着资源保护与增长极限的讨论成为固定的环保短语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first printed use of the phrase is not recorded, and the shift from 'recourse' to 'stock' in resource is gradual rather than dated to one text.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个短语确切的最早书证没有记录，而 resource 从「求助」到「存量」的转变是渐进的，无法归到某一文本。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same plere or resource stock that are easily confused; group two holds terms for running a supply down.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 plere 或 resource 词干、容易混淆的词；第二组是描述供给被耗尽的术语。

entries.definition: The process of emptying any stock; resource depletion adds what kind of stock is being emptied.
entries.definitionCN: 任何存量被倒空的过程；resource depletion 补充了被倒空的是哪类存量。

entries.definition: From re- 'again' plus plere 'to fill': the state of being filled again, literally the reverse of depletion.
entries.definitionCN: re-「再次」加 plere「装满」：再次被填满的状态，字面上是 depletion 的反面。

entries.definition: To fill a stock again; it is the action that prevents depletion.
entries.definitionCN: 把存量重新填满；正是防止耗竭的动作。

entries.definition: The verb for emptying a stock; the noun phrase names the resulting process.
entries.definitionCN: 表示倒空存量的动词；名词短语命名由此形成的过程。

entries.definition: The state of having nothing left; depletion can describe partial drawing down as well as the end.
entries.definitionCN: 什么都不剩的状态；depletion 既可指部分下降，也可指终局。

entries.definition: A condition of insufficient supply relative to demand, which depletion produces but does not name directly.
entries.definitionCN: 供给相对需求不足的状态，耗竭会造成它，但并不直接命名它。

entries.definition: Taking a renewable stock beyond its growth rate; it is the behaviour that drives depletion.
entries.definitionCN: 取用可再生存量超过其增长率；这是驱动耗竭的行为。

entries.definition: The measured drop in a stored supply, such as an aquifer's water level; depletion is the broader process.
entries.definitionCN: 储存供给测得的下降，如含水层水位；depletion 是更宽的过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: de- 'completely' + plere 'fill': depletion is un-filling, emptying a container to the bottom.
normal.cn: de-「完全」+ plere「装满」：depletion 就是卸空，把容器倒到底。

normal.en: re- 'again' + plere 'fill': replenish is the exact opposite action.
normal.cn: re-「再次」+ plere「装满」：replenish 正是相反的动作。

normal.en: The family runs deplete, depletion, depleted, replenish, repletion.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 deplete、depletion、depleted、replenish、repletion。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: groundwater resource depletion, resource depletion rate.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：地下水资源枯竭、资源耗竭速率。

normal.en: Resource first meant 'a way to recover', so depletion of a resource is the loss of a fallback.
normal.cn: resource 最初指「恢复的办法」，因此资源枯竭就是退路的丧失。

abstract.en: Picture a warehouse whose shelves are all empty boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一座仓库，架子上全是空盒子。

abstract.en: Picture a well that echoes back instead of filling.
abstract.cn: 想象一口井，回给你的是回声而不是水。

abstract.en: Picture a shared account drained by too many cards.
abstract.cn: 想象一个共享账户被太多张卡取空。

examples.en: Resource depletion forced the mine to close within a decade.
examples.cn: 资源枯竭迫使这座矿在十年内关闭。

examples.en: The island suffers resource depletion because its wells recharge slowly.
examples.cn: 这座岛的水井补给缓慢，因此遭受资源枯竭。

examples.en: Accounting for resource depletion changes the country's true savings rate.
examples.cn: 把资源耗竭计入账目会改变该国的真实储蓄率。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「resource（资源）+ depletion（倒空）」——资源被倒空 → 资源枯竭

root: resource 来自古法语 ressource，再上溯拉丁 resurgere「再起」= re-「再次」+ surgere「升起」；depletion 来自拉丁 deplere「倒空」= de-「完全」+ plere「装满」。两组词根方向相反。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one stock: a supply is full, it is drawn down, renewal cannot keep pace, the level falls, and the same phrase then names the state, specific aquifers, fish and ore, a national account, a security alarm and finally any shared pool.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个存量展开：储备是满的、被抽取、补充跟不上、水位下降，随后同一短语用来命名状态、具体含水层、鱼类与矿石、国民账户、安全警报，最后指任何共享储备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a warehouse that was full and is now reduced to empty frames.
core.cn: 核心意象：曾经满溢的仓库如今只剩空货架。

branches.en: PROCESS AND ACCOUNT: taking out exceeds putting back, and treasuries book the fall as lost capital.
branches.cn: 过程与账目：取出超过放回，财政部门把下降记为资本损失。

branches.en: STATE AND ALARM: the remaining stock is small, and politics reads that as dependence and danger.
branches.cn: 状态与警报：剩余存量很少，政治把这一点读作依赖与危险。

branches.en: FINITE STORES: groundwater, coal and ore have no human-scale replacement, so depletion is a countdown.
branches.cn: 有限存量：地下水、煤与矿石在人类尺度上无替代，因此耗竭是倒计时。

branches.en: RENEWABLE OVERHARVEST: fish and timber can renew, but only if harvest stays below regrowth.
branches.cn: 可再生资源的过度采获：鱼类与木材能再生，但前提是采获低于再生量。

branches.en: METAPHOR: attention, trust and talent behave like aquifers when withdrawals outrun recovery.
branches.cn: 比喻：当抽取超过恢复，注意力、信任与人才就像含水层一样。

intro.en: Resource depletion is a phrase of two Latin-derived nouns. The first traces to a verb of rising, the second to a verb of filling, so the two halves pull in opposite directions.
intro.cn: resource depletion 是两个拉丁来源名词构成的短语。前者上溯到「升起」的动词，后者上溯到「装满」的动词，因此两半方向相反。

latinIntro.en: Latin surgere 'to rise' gives resource and surge; Latin plere 'to fill' gives deplete, depletion, replete and replenish.
