latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 surgere「升起」衍生 resource 与 surge；拉丁 plere「装满」衍生 deplete、depletion、replete 与 replenish。

items.example: The prefix adds the idea of springing up again.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀增添「再次涌起」的意思。

items.example: The root supplies the image of a spring.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供泉水的意象。

items.meaning: a means of recovery; a stock
items.example: The forest is a slow resource.
items.exampleCN: 森林是一种恢复缓慢的资源。

items.example: The prefix pushes the filling out of the container.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把填充物推出容器。

items.example: The root is about fullness.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根关乎满与不满。

items.example: Pumping depletes the aquifer.
items.exampleCN: 抽水会耗尽含水层。

items.example: Depletion is the result of emptying.
items.exampleCN: depletion 就是倒空的结果。

items.example: Rain replenishes the reservoir.
items.exampleCN: 降雨补充水库。

items.example: Years of logging led to resource depletion in the valley.
items.exampleCN: 多年伐木导致这个山谷的资源枯竭。

definition_en: the reduction of a supply or quantity until little remains
core_image: 水库壁上留下一圈圈逐渐下降的旧水位线
scene: 干涸的水库岸边露出一圈圈旧水位线，原本淹在水下的坡面完全暴露。 The drought accelerated the depletion of the reservoir.
sceneCN: 这里 depletion 指「存量被持续取走而不断减少的过程」（第 1 个义项：供给或数量下降到所剩无几）；句意为干旱加速了水库水量的耗减。图中可辨识物件：层状水位线、裸露坡面、干裂泥面、远处坝体。

pos.zh: 耗竭；枯竭（可数或不可数）

derivatives.zh: 完整的；完成（同出 plere 词根）

senses.title: A supply being emptied
senses.definition: the process by which a supply or quantity is steadily reduced
senses.definitionCN: 供给或数量被持续减少的过程
senses.example: The drought accelerated the depletion of the reservoir.
senses.exampleCN: 干旱加速了水库水量的耗减。
senses.why: depletion comes from de- 'completely' plus plere 'to fill', so it names the un-filling of a container.
senses.whyCN: depletion 来自 de-「完全」加 plere「装满」，因此命名的是容器被卸空。

senses.title: Water tables falling
senses.definition: the lowering of groundwater because pumping removes water faster than rain replaces it
senses.definitionCN: 抽水快于降雨补给导致地下水位下降
senses.example: Farm pumping caused severe groundwater depletion.
senses.exampleCN: 农业抽水造成严重的地下水耗竭。
senses.why: an aquifer is a slow-filling container, so any pumping is literally depletion.
senses.whyCN: 含水层是一个装得很慢的容器，因此任何抽水都是字面上的 depletion。

senses.title: Thinning of the ozone layer
senses.definition: the loss of ozone molecules in the stratosphere, measured in concentration
senses.definitionCN: 平流层中臭氧分子的减少，以浓度计量
senses.example: Chlorofluorocarbons were blamed for ozone depletion.
senses.exampleCN: 氯氟烃被归咎为臭氧层损耗的原因。
senses.why: the same word works for an atmospheric layer because a layer is also a stock that can be thinned.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也适用于大气层，因为一层气体同样是可被削薄的存量。

senses.title: Fish and timber overharvested
senses.titleCN: 鱼类与木材被过度采获
senses.definition: the decline of a renewable stock when harvest outruns regrowth
senses.definitionCN: 采获超过再生量时可再生存量的下降
senses.example: The bay suffered depletion of its shellfish beds.
senses.exampleCN: 这片海湾的贝类床遭受耗竭。
senses.why: a renewable stock is still a stock, so the word applies whenever the take exceeds the return.
senses.whyCN: 可再生资源仍是存量，因此只要取用超过回补，这个词就适用。

senses.title: Finite reserves running out
senses.definition: the one-way reduction of coal, oil or ore that cannot be replaced
senses.definitionCN: 煤、石油或矿石无法补充的单向减少
senses.example: The field reached depletion after forty years of drilling.
senses.exampleCN: 这块油田在钻采四十年后走向枯竭。
senses.why: with no refill, depletion is not a cycle but a countdown to zero.
senses.whyCN: 没有补充时，耗竭不是循环，而是倒数到零。

senses.title: Emptying the body in old medicine
senses.definition: the historical medical sense of removing blood or fluid to restore balance
senses.definitionCN: 历史上通过放血或排液恢复平衡的医学含义
senses.example: Early physicians prescribed depletion for fever.
senses.exampleCN: 早期医生为发热开出排空疗法。
senses.why: the word's first English use was medical, since the body too was imagined as a container to be emptied.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早的英语用法是医学的，因为身体也被想象成可被倒空的容器。

senses.title: Natural capital written down
senses.definition: the drop in the recorded value of natural assets in national accounting
senses.definitionCN: 国民核算中自然资源资产记录价值的下降
senses.example: The audit separated depletion from ordinary depreciation.
senses.exampleCN: 审计把资源耗竭与普通折旧分开。
senses.why: economists use depletion for the using-up of a natural asset, just as accountants use depreciation for machines.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家用 depletion 指自然资产被用掉，正如会计用 depreciation 指机器折旧。

senses.title: Exhaustion of patience or energy
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：耐心或精力的耗尽
senses.definition: the running down of any personal or shared reserve such as energy, patience or trust
senses.definitionCN: 任何个人或共享储备的下降，如精力、耐心或信任
senses.example: The long shift produced a visible depletion of morale.
senses.exampleCN: 长班次造成了明显可见的士气耗减。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the container shape, so anything that can be used up can be said to undergo depletion.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留容器形态，因此任何能被用光的东西都可以说经历 depletion。

intro.en: Depletion comes from Latin deplere 'to empty out', built on de- 'completely' and plere 'to fill'. It entered English first as a medical term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: depletion 来自拉丁 deplere「倒空」，由 de-「完全」与 plere「装满」构成。它最初以医学术语进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Plere meant 'to fill'. It is the source of complete, supplement, replete and plenty's wider family.
items.cn: plere 意为「装满」。它是 complete、supplement、replete 以及 plenty 更广词族的来源。

items.en: De- 'completely' plus plere produced deplere 'to empty out, drain', the direct ancestor of the English noun.
items.cn: de-「完全」加 plere 构成 deplere「倒空、排干」，是英语名词的直接祖先。

items.en: The action noun depletio 'an emptying' supplied the shape of the English word.
items.cn: 动作名词 depletio「排空」提供了英语词的形态。

items.en: In seventeenth-century medicine depletion named the removal of blood or humours to restore balance.
items.cn: 在 17 世纪医学中，depletion 指放血或排液以恢复平衡。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the word had spread to any stock being used up, from mines to soil fertility.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，这个词已扩展到任何被用掉的存量，从矿藏到土壤肥力。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first use of the general non-medical sense is not recorded and cannot be tied to a single text.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：非医学的通用义最早出现在哪里没有记录，无法归到某一文本。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same plere family that are often mixed up; group two holds words for a supply falling low.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 plere 词族、常被混用的形式；第二组是描述供给走低的词。

entries.definition: The verb for emptying a stock; depletion is the process or result noun built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 表示倒空存量的动词；depletion 是由它构成的过程或结果名词。

entries.definition: The participle used as an adjective for a stock already emptied, as in depleted soil.
entries.definitionCN: 作形容词的分词，指已被掏空的存量，如贫瘠化的土壤。

entries.definition: Re- 'again' plus plere 'fill': the state of being filled again, the mirror image of depletion.
entries.definitionCN: re-「再次」加 plere「装满」：再次充满的状态，是 depletion 的镜像。

entries.definition: Com- 'thoroughly' plus plere: filled to the end, hence finished; it shares the root but not the emptying direction.
entries.definitionCN: com-「彻底」加 plere：填到底，因而完成；共享词根，但方向不是倒空。

entries.definition: The state of having nothing left; depletion also covers partial reductions before that end.
entries.definitionCN: 什么都不剩的状态；depletion 也涵盖到达终点前的部分减少。

entries.definition: Insufficiency relative to demand; depletion is the physical drawing down that can cause it.
entries.definitionCN: 相对需求而言的不足；depletion 是可能造成它的物理性减少。

entries.definition: A measured fall in a stored supply such as an aquifer; it is a reading, while depletion is the wider process.
entries.definitionCN: 储存供给测得的下降，如含水层；它是一个读数，而 depletion 是更宽的过程。

entries.definition: The act of using goods or resources; consumption may be sustainable, whereas depletion implies the stock cannot keep up.
entries.definitionCN: 使用商品或资源的行为；消费可以是可持续的，而 depletion 暗示存量跟不上。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: de- 'completely' + plere 'fill': depletion is the un-filling of a container.
normal.cn: de-「完全」+ plere「装满」：depletion 就是容器被卸空。

normal.en: The opposite is repletion, built with re- 'again' on the same root.
normal.cn: 反义词是 repletion，用同一词根加 re-「再次」构成。

normal.en: The family runs deplete, depletion, depleted, replete, replenish, complete.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 deplete、depletion、depleted、replete、replenish、complete。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: groundwater depletion, ozone depletion, resource depletion.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：地下水耗竭、臭氧层损耗、资源枯竭。

normal.en: Medicine used the word first: doctors depleted the body to restore balance.
normal.cn: 医学最早使用这个词：医生通过排空身体来恢复平衡。

abstract.en: Picture a cup that shows every sip it has ever lost.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子，把每一次被喝掉的量都显示出来。

abstract.en: Picture a battery whose bars disappear one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一块电池，格子一格一格地消失。

abstract.en: Picture a reservoir wall wearing rings like a tree's age lines.
abstract.cn: 想象水库的墙长着年轮一样的圈。

examples.en: Ozone depletion peaked over Antarctica in spring.
examples.cn: 臭氧层损耗在南极上空于春季达到高峰。

examples.en: Depletion of the aquifer has lowered the whole valley.
examples.cn: 含水层的耗竭使整个河谷下沉。

examples.en: The report links soil depletion to falling yields.
examples.cn: 报告把土壤耗竭与产量下降联系起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「de（向下）+ pletion（填满）」——把填满的东西往下卸空 → 耗竭

root: 拉丁 deplere「倒空」= de-「完全」+ plere「装满」；动作名词 depletio。plere 同族另有 complete、replete、supplement、replenish。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one container: a stock is full, something withdraws from it, the level falls, and the same noun then names water tables, an ozone layer, fish, ore, an old medical practice, a national account and finally a personal reserve.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个容器展开：存量是满的、有东西被取走、水位下降，随后同一名词用来命名地下水位、臭氧层、鱼类、矿石、旧医学疗法、国民账户，最后指个人储备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rings of old water levels left on the wall of a drying reservoir.
core.cn: 核心意象：干涸水库的墙上留下一圈圈旧水位线。

branches.en: GENERAL AND MEDICAL: any container can be emptied, whether a reservoir or a body treated by old medicine.
branches.cn: 通用与医学：任何容器都可被倒空，无论是水库还是旧医学处理的身体。

branches.en: WATER AND AIR: aquifers and the ozone layer are both slow-filling stocks measured by level or concentration.
branches.cn: 水与空气：含水层与臭氧层都是补充缓慢的存量，按水位或浓度计量。

branches.en: HARVEST AND RESERVE: renewable stocks can still be overharvested, and finite reserves simply count down.
branches.cn: 采获与储量：可再生存量仍会被过度采获，有限储量则只是倒数。

branches.en: ACCOUNTING: treasuries record the using-up of natural assets as a loss.
branches.cn: 核算：财政部门把自然资产被用掉记为损失。

branches.en: PERSONAL RESERVE: energy, patience and trust behave like stocks once withdrawals outrun recovery.
branches.cn: 个人储备：一旦抽取超过恢复，精力、耐心与信任就像存量一样。

intro.en: Depletion is a Latin action noun: a prefix of completion, a verb of filling, and a suffix of result. The same three pieces build a large English family.
intro.cn: depletion 是一个拉丁动作名词：表示「完全」的前缀、表示「装满」的动词、表示结果的后缀。同三块构件构成一个庞大的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin deplere and depletio give deplete and depletion; plere also gives complete, replete, supplement and replenish.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 deplere 与 depletio 衍生 deplete 与 depletion；plere 还衍生 complete、replete、supplement 与 replenish。

items.example: The prefix reverses the filling.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「装填」倒转过来。

items.example: The root supplies the container image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供容器意象。

items.example: The verb means to un-fill a vessel.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词意为把容器卸空。

items.example: Depletion is the result of emptying.
items.exampleCN: depletion 是倒空的结果。

items.example: Pumping depletes the aquifer.
items.exampleCN: 抽水会耗尽含水层。

items.example: The drought accelerated the depletion of the reservoir.
items.exampleCN: 干旱加速了水库水量的耗减。

items.example: The set is complete.
items.exampleCN: 这一套是完整的。

items.example: The table was replete with dishes.
items.exampleCN: 桌上摆满了菜。

items.example: Rain replenishes the reservoir.
items.exampleCN: 降雨补充水库。

latinEntries.meaning: a filling; in later use an emptying

definition_en: the planting of trees to create a forest on land that was not recently wooded
core_image: 一片裸露的坡地被成排幼树覆盖，树苗的护套排成网格
scene: 裸露的坡地上，人们按网格栽下成排树苗，护套在风里直立。 The project's afforestation covered the bare slope within five years.
sceneCN: 这里 afforestation 指「在原本无林或长期无林的土地上造林」（第 1 个义项：通过栽种树木建立新的森林覆盖）；句意为该项目的造林工程在五年内覆盖了这片裸坡。图中可辨识物件：树苗、护套、网格状栽植线、坡地。

senses.title: Planting trees to make a new forest
senses.definition: the deliberate planting of trees on bare or long-cleared land so that a forest develops
senses.definitionCN: 在裸露或长期清除过的土地上刻意栽树，使森林得以形成
senses.example: The project's afforestation covered the bare slope within five years.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目的造林工程在五年内覆盖了这片裸坡。
senses.why: ad- 'to' plus forest plus -ation: the act of turning land into forest, so the noun names the conversion.
senses.whyCN: ad-「向」加 forest 加 -ation：把土地变成森林的行为，因此名词命名的是这种转变。

senses.title: A government programme
senses.definition: a public scheme with targets, subsidies and nurseries for planting trees
senses.definitionCN: 带有目标、补贴与苗圃的公共植树计划
senses.example: The national afforestation programme hired village crews.
senses.exampleCN: 国家造林计划雇用了村庄里的作业队。
senses.why: a practice becomes a programme when a state sets a target and pays for seedlings.
senses.whyCN: 当国家设定目标并为树苗付费，一种做法就变成一项计划。

senses.title: Restoring degraded land
senses.definition: the use of tree cover to hold soil, shade crops and slow erosion on worn-out land
senses.definitionCN: 在退化土地上用树冠固土、遮荫作物并减缓侵蚀
senses.example: Afforestation stabilized the sand dunes along the road.
senses.exampleCN: 造林稳定了公路旁的沙丘。
senses.why: once land is worn out, trees are a tool for repairing its surface and water cycle.
senses.whyCN: 土地一旦退化，树木就成了修复地表与水分循环的工具。

senses.title: A carbon-removal measure
senses.definition: tree planting counted as a way to take carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 把植树计为从大气中移除二氧化碳的一种方式
senses.example: The firm bought afforestation credits to offset its flights.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司购买造林信用来抵消其航班排放。
senses.why: growing trees store carbon in wood, so planting becomes a measurable climate instrument.
senses.whyCN: 生长的树把碳储存在木质中，因此植树成为可测量的气候工具。

senses.title: Urban and shelterbelt planting
senses.definition: the planting of tree belts to shade streets, block wind or hold a city's edge
senses.definitionCN: 种植树带以遮荫街道、挡风或界定城市边缘
senses.example: Afforestation along the ring road cut dust by half.
senses.exampleCN: 环城路旁的造林把扬尘减少了一半。
senses.why: the same act is used at the scale of streets and field edges, where a line of trees does the work of a forest.
senses.whyCN: 同一行为也用于街道与田边尺度，那里一排树就起到森林的作用。

senses.title: Establishing a commercial plantation
senses.definition: the planting of fast-growing trees as a crop for timber, pulp or fuel
senses.definitionCN: 把速生树当作木材、纸浆或燃料作物来种植
senses.example: Afforestation for pulp replaced part of the native scrub.
senses.exampleCN: 为纸浆而进行的造林取代了一部分原生灌丛。
senses.why: industry calls a planted crop a forest too, so the word also names plantation establishment.
senses.whyCN: 产业也把人种的作物叫作森林，因此这个词也指人工林建设。

senses.title: The technical contrast with reforestation
senses.definition: the technical label for planting on land that was not forest in the recent past, as opposed to replanting a cleared forest
senses.definitionCN: 指在近期内并非林地的土地上造林，以区别于在被砍伐的林地上重新植树
senses.example: The inventory separates afforestation from reforestation.
senses.exampleCN: 这份清单把造林与再造林分开。
senses.why: climate accounting needs a sharp line between adding new forest and replacing lost forest, and this is the line.
senses.whyCN: 气候核算需要在「新增森林」与「替代失去的森林」之间划清界线，这就是那条界线。

senses.title: Building cover where none existed
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：在原本无覆盖处建立覆盖
senses.definition: any deliberate building of a canopy-like layer over an exposed system
senses.definitionCN: 任何在裸露系统上有意建立冠层式覆盖的行为
senses.example: The team called its data afforestation a canopy over the archive.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把自己的数据造林称作档案上的一层树冠。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the shape of planting a cover on bare ground, so it fits metadata, shade and insulation.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留「在裸地上种覆盖」的形态，因此适用于元数据、遮荫与隔热。

intro.en: Afforestation comes from Medieval Latin afforestare 'to bring land into forest', built on ad- 'to' and forestis, a Late Latin word for woodland outside a park. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: afforestation 来自中世纪拉丁 afforestare「把土地纳入森林」，由 ad-「向」与 forestis 构成；forestis 是晚期拉丁语中指公园外林地的词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Foris meant 'outside, out of doors', related to fores 'door'. The image is the ground beyond the gate.
items.cn: foris 意为「外面、户外」，与 fores「门」有关。意象是门外的土地。

items.en: Forestis silva meant 'woodland outside the walls of a park', the open wooded ground reserved for hunting.
items.cn: forestis silva 意为「公园围墙之外的林地」，即留作狩猎的开阔林地。

items.en: Old French forest named a large wooded tract, often a royal hunting preserve, and passed into English as forest.
items.cn: 古法语 forest 指大片林地，常为王室猎场，后进入英语成为 forest。

items.en: Ad- 'to' plus forestis produced afforestare, first a legal act: to bring land under forest law, not necessarily to plant trees.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 forestis 构成 afforestare，最初是法律行为：把土地纳入森林法，不一定栽树。

items.en: English afforest first carried the legal sense, and the modern sense of planting trees developed later.
items.cn: 英语 afforest 最初承袭法律义，现代「栽树」义较晚才发展出来。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first use of afforestation in the planting sense is not fixed, and the legal and planting senses overlap in early records.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：afforestation 在「栽树」义上的确切首见时间没有定说，早期记录中法律义与栽植义互相交叠。

note.en: Group one holds forest words that differ by prefix and are routinely confused; group two holds related land-cover practices.
note.cn: 第一组是前缀不同、常被混淆的森林词；第二组是相关的土地覆盖做法。

entries.definition: Replanting trees on land that was forest until recently; afforestation instead starts from land that was not forest.
entries.definitionCN: 在近期仍是林地的土地上重新植树；afforestation 则从非林地开始。

entries.definition: The clearing of forest, the opposite act; the two words are often paired in climate reports.
entries.definitionCN: 清除森林，是相反的行为；两个词常在气候报告中并列出现。

entries.definition: A general word for establishing forest, covering both planting new and replanting old.
entries.definitionCN: 建立森林的统称，涵盖新造与重植两种情况。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to plant with trees or to bring under forest; the noun names the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 意为栽树或使成为林地的动词；名词命名这一活动。

entries.definition: The everyday phrase for putting trees in the ground, at any scale; afforestation implies a forest result.
entries.definitionCN: 指把树栽进土里的日常说法，任何规模皆可；afforestation 暗示形成森林的结果。

entries.definition: The cultivation and management of trees as a crop; it is the discipline behind afforestation.
entries.definitionCN: 把树木作为作物来培育与管理的学问；它是造林背后的学科。

entries.definition: Making damaged land usable again, by any means; tree planting is only one method.
entries.definitionCN: 用任何手段使受损土地重新可用；植树只是其中一种方法。

entries.definition: A system that absorbs more carbon than it releases; a new forest may become one.
entries.definitionCN: 吸收碳多于释放碳的系统；新森林可以成为其中之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ad- 'to' + forest + -ation: the act of turning land to forest.
normal.cn: ad-「向」+ forest + -ation：把土地变成森林的行为。

normal.en: The prefix pair tells the story: afforestation adds forest, reforestation adds it back, deforestation takes it away.
normal.cn: 前缀三兄弟讲清方向：afforestation 新增森林，reforestation 补回森林，deforestation 拿走森林。

normal.en: The family runs afforest, afforested, forest, forestry, reforestation, deforestation.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 afforest、afforested、forest、forestry、reforestation、deforestation。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the policy sense: afforestation project, afforestation programme, afforestation rate.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出政策义：造林项目、造林计划、造林率。

normal.en: Forestis meant land outside the park wall, so afforestation originally meant bringing land under forest law.
normal.cn: forestis 指公园墙外的土地，因此 afforestation 最初指把土地纳入森林法。

abstract.en: Picture a green blanket sewn onto a bare hill stitch by stitch.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绿毯被一针一针缝到光秃的山坡上。

abstract.en: Picture a grid of tiny umbrellas that will grow into a roof.
abstract.cn: 想象一片小伞排成网格，日后长成屋顶。

abstract.en: Picture a field learning to cast shade on itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田学会为自己投下阴影。

examples.en: Afforestation on the plateau slowed the wind erosion.
examples.cn: 高原上的造林减缓了风蚀。

examples.en: The plan promises afforestation of one million hectares.
examples.cn: 该计划承诺造林一百万公顷。

examples.en: Critics note that afforestation can lower stream flow.
examples.cn: 批评者指出，造林可能减少河流流量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「af（向）+ forest（森林）+ ation（行为）」——把土地变成森林 → 造林

root: ad-「向」+ forest + -ation；forest 经古法语来自晚期拉丁 forestis silva「公园墙外的林地」，再上溯拉丁 foris「外面」，与 fores「门」有关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act: bare land is planted, seedlings close into rows, a canopy forms, and the same noun then names a state programme, a repair method, a carbon tool, an urban belt, a plantation, a technical contrast and finally any added cover.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个动作展开：裸地被栽种、树苗连成行、树冠形成，随后同一名词用来命名国家计划、修复方法、碳工具、城市林带、人工林、技术区分，最后指任何新增覆盖。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bare slope planted with a grid of young trees in protective sleeves.
core.cn: 核心意象：裸坡上按网格栽满带护套的幼树。

branches.en: THE BASE ACT: new forest is created, and the technical line separates it from replanting an old forest.
branches.cn: 基本行为：新森林被造出，技术界线把它与重植旧林分开。

branches.en: PROGRAMME: targets, subsidies and nurseries turn planting into public policy.
branches.cn: 计划：目标、补贴与苗圃把栽植变成公共政策。

branches.en: REPAIR AND BELT: trees hold worn soil and line streets as shelter.
branches.cn: 修复与林带：树木固住退化土壤，也沿街成带。

branches.en: CARBON AND CROP: growing wood stores carbon, and fast-growing trees become a harvest.
branches.cn: 碳与作物：生长的木质储存碳，速生树也成为收成。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any exposed system can be given a canopy of cover.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何裸露系统都可被加上一层冠盖。

intro.en: Afforestation is a Latin-derived noun with a transparent build: a prefix of direction, a forest root and a suffix of action. The family is large and mostly legal or botanical in origin.
intro.cn: afforestation 是一个拉丁来源名词，构造透明：方向前缀、森林词根与动作后缀。词族庞大，来源多为法律或植物学。

latinIntro.en: Latin foris 'outside' and forestis 'woodland outside the park' give forest; afforestare adds ad- 'to'; -atio supplies the action noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 foris「外面」与 forestis「公园外林地」衍生 forest；afforestare 加 ad-「向」；-atio 提供动作名词。

items.example: The prefix marks direction toward a new state.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标记朝新状态的方向。

items.structure: Latin adverb foris 'outside, out of doors'
items.example: Forestis land lay outside the park wall.
items.exampleCN: forestis 的土地位于公园墙外。

items.structure: Late Latin forestis (silva) 'woodland outside the park'
items.example: The word named hunting ground beyond the wall.
items.exampleCN: 这个词命名墙外的猎场。

items.structure: Old French forest < Late Latin forestis
items.example: The forest returned after the planting.
items.exampleCN: 栽植之后森林回来了。

items.example: They afforested the eroded valley.
items.exampleCN: 他们在受侵蚀的河谷造林。

items.example: Afforestation names the whole act.
items.exampleCN: afforestation 命名整个行为。

items.example: Forestry sets the planting schedule.
items.exampleCN: 林业部门制定栽植时间表。

items.example: Reforestation followed the fire.
items.exampleCN: 火灾之后进行了再造林。

items.example: Deforestation exposed the hillside.
items.exampleCN: 毁林使山坡裸露。

latinEntries.meaning: of woodland outside the park; wooded
latinEntries.meaningCN: 公园外林地的；林木覆盖的

latinEntries.structure: afforestare, afforestavi, afforestatum (verb, first conjugation; Medieval Latin)
latinEntries.meaning: to bring land under forest law; to plant with trees
latinEntries.meaningCN: 把土地纳入森林法；造林

definition_en: the way land is used, or the purpose for which a piece of land is managed
core_image: 一块地被划成不同颜色的区块，分别代表耕作、居住与林地
scene: 谷地被分成数块，颜色分别代表耕作、居住与保留林地。 The county maps land use every ten years.
sceneCN: 这里 land use 指「土地被派作何种用途」（第 1 个义项：一块地用于耕作、居住、工业或保留等的目的）；句意为该县每十年绘制一次土地利用图。图中可辨识物件：彩色地块、分界线、田块、林地。

pos.zh: 土地利用；土地用途（可数或不可数）

senses.title: The purpose land is put to
senses.definition: the function a piece of land serves, such as farming, housing, industry or conservation
senses.definitionCN: 一块地所承担的功能，如耕作、居住、工业或保护
senses.example: The county maps land use every ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 该县每十年绘制一次土地利用图。
senses.why: land names the surface and use names its employment, so the compound simply asks what the ground is employed for.
senses.whyCN: land 指地表，use 指它的用途，因此这个复合词就是问这块地在被用来做什么。

senses.title: The pattern across a region
senses.definition: the arrangement of different purposes across a whole area
senses.definitionCN: 整个区域内不同用途的分布安排
senses.example: The valley's land use is a patchwork of fields and towns.
senses.exampleCN: 这个河谷的土地利用是田块与城镇拼成的拼图。
senses.why: one field has a use, but a region has a pattern, and planners speak of the pattern as the land use.
senses.whyCN: 一块田有一个用途，而一个区域有一种格局，规划者把这种格局也称作土地利用。

senses.title: Zoning and planning decisions
senses.definition: the rules that assign permitted purposes to parcels of land
senses.definitionCN: 给各地块分配允许用途的规则
senses.example: Land use rules kept the factory out of the village.
senses.exampleCN: 土地用途规则把工厂挡在村庄之外。
senses.why: a purpose becomes a rule when a council writes it into a zoning map.
senses.whyCN: 当议会把一种用途写进分区图，用途就变成规则。

senses.title: Change over time
senses.definition: the conversion of land from one purpose to another, tracked as land-use change
senses.definitionCN: 土地从一种用途转为另一种，作为土地利用变化来追踪
senses.example: Satellite images revealed rapid land use change at the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星图像显示海岸带发生了迅速的土地利用变化。
senses.why: once two maps exist, the difference between them becomes a process with its own name.
senses.whyCN: 一旦有两张地图，它们之间的差异就变成一个有自己的名字的过程。

senses.title: Farm and forest categories
senses.definition: the classification of land as cropland, pasture, orchard or woodland
senses.definitionCN: 把土地归为耕地、牧场、果园或林地
senses.example: The survey recorded agricultural land use acre by acre.
senses.exampleCN: 调查逐英亩记录了农业土地利用。
senses.why: statistics need buckets, so each purpose becomes a category in a land-use table.
senses.whyCN: 统计需要分类格，于是每种用途都成为土地利用表中的一类。

senses.title: An urban development label
senses.definition: the mix of residential, commercial and industrial purposes in a built-up area
senses.definitionCN: 建成区内居住、商业与工业用途的组合
senses.example: Mixed land use keeps shops within walking distance.
senses.exampleCN: 混合土地利用让商店保持在步行距离内。
senses.why: cities combine purposes in one block, and the label describes that combination.
senses.whyCN: 城市在同一个街区组合多种用途，这个标签描述的就是这种组合。

senses.title: A variable in impact analysis
senses.titleCN: 影响分析中的一个变量
senses.definition: the input to models of runoff, emissions, habitat loss or transport demand
senses.definitionCN: 径流、排放、生境丧失或交通需求模型中的输入项
senses.example: The model linked land use to phosphorus runoff.
senses.exampleCN: 该模型把土地利用与磷径流联系起来。
senses.why: researchers need a single word for what people do to the surface, and this compound is that word.
senses.whyCN: 研究者需要用一个词概括人对地表所做的事，这个复合词就是那个词。

senses.title: Allocation of any space
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何空间的用途分配
senses.definition: the assignment of purposes to any limited space, physical or conceptual
senses.definitionCN: 给任何有限空间分配用途，无论是实体还是概念空间
senses.example: The studio reviewed land use inside the page layout.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室检视了页面版面内部的「土地利用」。
senses.why: the metaphor treats any layout as a territory to be zoned.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把任何版面都当作一块需要分区的领土。

intro.en: Land use joins the native Germanic noun land with use, a noun from Latin usus 'employment'. The compound is a modern planning term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: land use 把日耳曼本族名词 land 与 use 组合起来；use 来自拉丁 usus「使用」。这个复合词是现代规划术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Land is a Germanic word for ground, territory or country, with cognates across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: land 是日耳曼语中表示地面、领土或国家的词，在其他日耳曼语言中也有同源词。

items.en: The deeper root often proposed for land is a reconstruction; its exact shape and meaning are not attested directly.
items.cn: 常为 land 提出的更深词根属于重构形式，其确切形态与意义没有直接实证。

items.en: Uti meant 'to use, employ, enjoy'. Its past participle usus supplied the noun for use and practice.
items.cn: uti 意为「使用、运用、享有」。其过去分词 usus 提供了表示使用与惯例的名词。

items.en: Old French us carried the Latin noun into English, where use named both the act and the purpose of a thing.
items.cn: 古法语 us 把这个拉丁名词带入英语，use 既指行为，也指事物的用途。

items.en: Land use became a fixed term with twentieth-century town planning and resource surveys.
items.cn: land use 随 20 世纪的城镇规划与资源调查成为固定术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Germanic root of land and the pre-Latin root of uti are both unsettled, and the first printed use of the compound is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：land 的日耳曼语之前词根与 uti 的拉丁语之前词根都无定论，这个复合词的最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds land terms that are constantly mistaken for land use; group two holds planning ideas that work alongside it.
note.cn: 第一组是常被误当作 land use 的土地术语；第二组是与之配合的规划概念。

entries.definition: The physical surface actually present, such as grass, concrete or water; land use is the purpose behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 实际存在的物理地表，如草地、混凝土或水；land use 是背后的用途。

entries.definition: The legal arrangement of who owns or occupies land, not what it is used for.
entries.definitionCN: 关于谁拥有或占有土地的法律安排，而非土地作何用途。

entries.definition: A natural feature of the surface such as a ridge or valley; it describes shape, not human purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 山脊、河谷等自然地表形态；描述形状，不描述人的用途。

entries.definition: The process of building on land, which changes its use but is not the same as the use itself.
entries.definitionCN: 在土地上建造的过程；它改变用途，但不等同于用途本身。

entries.definition: The division of land into zones with permitted uses; it is the instrument that enforces land use.
entries.definitionCN: 把土地划成有允许用途的区；它是执行土地利用的工具。

entries.definition: The day-to-day care of land, including soil, water and vegetation, rather than its assigned purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 对土地包括土壤、水与植被的日常照料，而非其被派定的用途。

entries.definition: The planning of activities across space, of which land use planning is one part.
entries.definitionCN: 对空间中的活动进行规划，土地利用规划是其中一部分。

entries.definition: How heavily a parcel is worked, such as yields per hectare; it measures intensity rather than purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 一块地被使用的强度，如每公顷产量；它衡量强度而非用途。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: land + use: the compound asks what the ground is employed for.
normal.cn: land + use：这个复合词问的是这块地被用来做什么。

normal.en: The family runs land, use, useful, usage, land-use planning, land cover.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 land、use、useful、usage、land-use planning、land cover。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: land use planning, land use change, land use map.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：土地利用规划、土地利用变化、土地利用图。

normal.en: Land cover is what you see; land use is why it is there.
normal.cn: 土地覆盖是你看到的，土地利用是它为什么在那里。

normal.en: Latin usus 'use' also gives usage, usual and usury's older sense of use.
normal.cn: 拉丁 usus「使用」也衍生 usage、usual 以及 usury 较早的「使用」义。

abstract.en: Picture a quilt whose patches are labeled by what they do.
abstract.cn: 想象一床拼布被，每块布都标着它的用途。

abstract.en: Picture a map that colors the ground by intention, not by grass.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，按意图而不是按草色给土地上色。

abstract.en: Picture a desk divided into zones for writing, eating and sleeping.
abstract.cn: 想象一张书桌被划成写字、吃饭与睡觉的区域。

examples.en: Land use change is the main driver of habitat loss.
examples.cn: 土地利用变化是生境丧失的主要驱动因素。

examples.en: The council published a new land use plan for the valley.
examples.cn: 议会发布了这个河谷的新土地利用规划。

examples.en: Mixed land use reduces the need to drive.
examples.cn: 混合土地利用减少了开车的需要。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「land（土地）+ use（用途）」——土地派什么用场 → 土地利用

root: land 为日耳曼本族词，更深词根属重构；use 经古法语 us 来自拉丁 usus「使用」，再上溯 uti「使用」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one surface: a purpose is assigned, patches form a pattern, rules fix it, maps track change, statistics classify it, cities mix it, models read it, and finally any space can be zoned.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个地表展开：用途被派定、地块形成格局、规则将其固定、地图追踪变化、统计将其分类、城市将其混合、模型读取它，最后任何空间都可被分区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a valley divided into colored patches, each standing for a purpose.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片谷地被分成彩色地块，每块代表一种用途。

branches.en: PURPOSE AND CATEGORY: a parcel serves a function, and statistics sort those functions into buckets.
branches.cn: 用途与分类：地块承担功能，统计再把功能分进格子。

branches.en: PATTERN AND CHANGE: many parcels form a regional pattern, and two maps in time reveal its change.
branches.cn: 格局与变化：许多地块形成区域格局，两个时间点的地图揭示其变化。

branches.en: RULES AND MIX: zoning fixes permitted uses, and cities combine several in one block.
branches.cn: 规则与混合：分区固定允许用途，城市在同一街区组合多种用途。

branches.en: MODEL INPUT: runoff, emissions and transport models take land use as a variable.
branches.cn: 模型输入：径流、排放与交通模型把土地利用当作变量。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any limited layout can be treated as territory to be zoned.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何有限版面都可当作需要分区的领土。

intro.en: Land use is a compound of a native noun and a Latin-derived noun. Both halves are simple free forms rather than prefixes or suffixes, but each builds a large family.
intro.cn: land use 是日耳曼本族名词与拉丁来源名词的复合。两半都是简单的自由词形，而非前缀或后缀，但各自构成庞大的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin uti 'to use' and usus 'use' give use, usage, useful, useless and misuse; land is native Germanic and has no Latin entry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 uti「使用」与 usus「使用」衍生 use、usage、useful、useless 与 misuse；land 是日耳曼本族词，没有拉丁条目。

items.example: The land rose toward the ridge.
items.exampleCN: 土地向山脊抬升。

items.example: The field's use is pasture.
items.exampleCN: 这块地的用途是牧场。

items.structure: Latin noun usus, usus (m., fourth declension)
items.example: The Latin noun is the base of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是英语词的基底。

items.example: The map is useful for planning.
items.exampleCN: 这张地图对规划有用。

items.example: A map without a legend is useless.
items.exampleCN: 没有图例的地图毫无用处。

items.meaning: the manner or amount of use
items.example: Water usage fell after the meter was installed.
items.exampleCN: 装表后用水量下降了。

items.example: The land user must file a return.
items.exampleCN: 土地使用者必须提交申报。

items.example: Misuse of the slope caused erosion.
items.exampleCN: 坡地的误用造成了侵蚀。

items.example: The county maps land use every ten years.
items.exampleCN: 该县每十年绘制一次土地利用图。

latinEntries.structure: uti, usus sum (deponent verb, third conjugation)

definition_zh: 土地退化；土地质量与生产力下降
definition_en: the decline in the quality and productivity of land, often through erosion, salinization or loss of nutrients
core_image: 一片表土被冲走，露出砾石与沟壑的坡地
scene: 雨水在坡面冲出沟壑，肥沃表土被带走，只剩砾石与硬土。 Overgrazing accelerated land degradation across the plain.
sceneCN: 这里 land degradation 指「土地质量与生产力下降的过程」（第 1 个义项：因侵蚀、盐化或养分流失而使土地变差）；句意为过度放牧加速了平原上的土地退化。图中可辨识物件：冲沟、裸露砾石、被带走的表土、稀疏草皮。

senses.title: Land losing its quality
senses.definition: the reduction of the capacity of land to support plants, animals and people
senses.definitionCN: 土地支撑植物、动物与人的能力下降
senses.example: Overgrazing accelerated land degradation across the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 过度放牧加速了平原上的土地退化。
senses.why: degradation is a downward step in rank or quality, so the phrase says land has been moved down a grade.
senses.whyCN: degradation 是等级或质量的下降，因此短语说的是土地被降了一档。

senses.title: Topsoil washed or blown away
senses.definition: the loss of topsoil through water and wind erosion
senses.definitionCN: 表土因水蚀与风蚀而流失
senses.example: Gullies on the slope show severe land degradation.
senses.exampleCN: 坡面上的冲沟显示土地严重退化。
senses.why: the fertile layer is thin, so once it leaves, the ground's grade drops immediately.
senses.whyCN: 肥沃层很薄，一旦离开，土地的等级立刻下降。

senses.title: Salt rising in irrigated soil
senses.definition: the accumulation of salts at the surface of irrigated land, which blocks crop growth
senses.definitionCN: 灌溉土地表层盐分积累，阻碍作物生长
senses.example: Poor drainage caused land degradation in the irrigated fields.
senses.exampleCN: 排水不良导致灌溉农田土地退化。
senses.why: water carries salt upward as it evaporates, and a white crust is another visible downgrade.
senses.whyCN: 水在蒸发时把盐带到表层，白霜是另一种可见的降级。

senses.title: Nutrients and organic matter falling
senses.definition: the depletion of soil carbon, nitrogen and organic matter under continuous cropping
senses.definitionCN: 连续耕作下土壤碳、氮与有机质的耗减
senses.example: Continuous maize farming led to land degradation.
senses.exampleCN: 连续种植玉米导致土地退化。
senses.why: a soil is a stock of fertility, and harvesting without return lowers that stock.
senses.whyCN: 土壤是肥力的存量，只收获不回补就会降低这个存量。

senses.title: The dryland path toward desert
senses.titleCN: 旱地向荒漠演变的路径
senses.definition: the process by which dry land loses vegetation and approaches desert conditions
senses.definitionCN: 旱地失去植被并接近荒漠状态的过程
senses.example: The Sahel's land degradation is tracked alongside drought.
senses.exampleCN: 萨赫勒的土地退化与干旱一起被追踪。
senses.why: in dry regions, degradation and desertification are neighbours, the first a decline and the second its endpoint.
senses.whyCN: 在干旱地区，退化与荒漠化相邻，前者是下降，后者是终点。

senses.title: A loss in farm output and value
senses.titleCN: 农业产出与价值的损失
senses.definition: the economic cost when yields fall and land values decline
senses.definitionCN: 产量下降与地价下跌带来的经济代价
senses.example: The ministry counted land degradation as a rural income loss.
senses.exampleCN: 该部把土地退化计为农村收入损失。
senses.why: once productivity is measured in money, a physical downgrade becomes a line in a budget.
senses.whyCN: 当生产力用钱衡量，物理上的降级就变成预算里的一行。

senses.title: A global indicator with a target
senses.definition: the measured variable used in international goals such as land degradation neutrality
senses.definitionCN: 用于土地退化零增长等国际目标的测量变量
senses.example: The report set a baseline for land degradation neutrality.
senses.exampleCN: 报告为土地退化零增长设定了基线。
senses.why: a process becomes governable when it is given a baseline, a target and a reporting cycle.
senses.whyCN: 当一个过程有了基线、目标与报告周期，它就变得可治理。

senses.title: Any foundation losing strength
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何基础在削弱
senses.definition: the weakening of any base that a system stands on, physical or institutional
senses.definitionCN: 系统所依赖的任何基础在削弱，无论是实体还是制度
senses.example: The editor called the broken archive land degradation of the project.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑把损毁的档案称作项目的土地退化。
senses.why: the metaphor needs only a supporting layer and a downward change, so it fits trust, archives and institutions.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只需一个支撑层与向下的变化，因此适用于信任、档案与制度。

intro.en: Land degradation joins the native noun land with degradation, from Latin degradare 'to lower in rank', built on de- 'down' and gradus 'step'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: land degradation 把本族名词 land 与 degradation 组合起来；degradation 来自拉丁 degradare「降低等级」，由 de-「向下」与 gradus「台阶」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gradus meant 'step, pace, degree, rank'. The word pictures a staircase, where each position is a grade above the last.
items.cn: gradus 意为「台阶、步、等级、地位」。这个词描绘一段楼梯，每一位置都比下一级高。

items.en: De- 'down' plus gradus produced degradare 'to reduce in rank, demote', a word of social position before it was a word of soil.
items.cn: de-「向下」加 gradus 构成 degradare「降低等级、贬职」，先用于社会地位，后用于土壤。

items.en: Old French degrader carried the verb into English, first in the sense of lowering someone's rank or dignity.
items.cn: 古法语 degrader 把这个动词带入英语，最初指降低某人的等级或尊严。

items.en: Degradation kept the moral and social sense for centuries, and the physical sense of lowered quality came later.
items.cn: degradation 数百年间保留道德与社会义，表示质量下降的物理义较晚出现。

items.en: Soil scientists in the twentieth century applied the word to land, where a lost topsoil layer is literally a lost grade.
items.cn: 20 世纪的土壤学家把这个词用于土地，在那里失去表土层就是字面意义上的失去一档。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the exact first use of the land phrase is not fixed, and the pre-Germanic root of land is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：土地短语的确切首见时间没有定说，land 的日耳曼语之前词根属于重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same gradus family that are easily confused; group two holds processes that overlap with land degradation.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 gradus 词族、容易混淆的形式；第二组是与土地退化重叠的过程。

entries.definition: A lowering in quality or rank of anything; land degradation specifies the thing that is lowered.
entries.definitionCN: 任何事物质量或等级的下降；land degradation 指明被降低的是什么。

entries.definition: The verb for lowering quality or rank; the noun names the process and result.
entries.definitionCN: 表示降低质量或等级的动词；名词命名过程与结果。

entries.definition: Up- 'up' plus gradus: to raise to a higher grade, the exact reverse of degrade.
entries.definitionCN: up-「向上」加 gradus：提升到更高等级，正是 degrade 的反向。

entries.definition: From gradus 'step': proceeding step by step; it shares the staircase image but not the downward meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 gradus「台阶」：一步一步进行；共享楼梯意象，但不含下降义。

entries.definition: The conversion of dry land toward desert; it is one severe form of land degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 旱地向荒漠转变；它是土地退化的一种严重形式。

entries.definition: The removal of soil by water or wind, a common cause of land degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 水或风带走土壤，是土地退化的常见成因。

entries.definition: The build-up of salts in soil, another pathway to degraded land.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中盐分积累，是土地退化的另一条路径。

entries.definition: The using-up of soil nutrients; it stresses the stock of fertility rather than the land's overall grade.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤养分的耗减；强调肥力存量，而非土地的整体等级。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: de- 'down' + gradus 'step': degradation is a step down, and land degradation is that step on soil.
normal.cn: de-「向下」+ gradus「台阶」：degradation 是下一级台阶，土地退化就是土壤上的这一步。

normal.en: The opposite is upgrade, built with up- on the same root.
normal.cn: 反义词是 upgrade，用同一词根加 up- 构成。

normal.en: The family runs degrade, degradation, degraded, degradable, upgrade, gradual.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 degrade、degradation、degraded、degradable、upgrade、gradual。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: land degradation neutrality, land degradation assessment.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：土地退化零增长、土地退化评估。

normal.en: The word began with rank, not soil: to degrade a person was to lower their standing.
normal.cn: 这个词最初用于等级而非土壤：degrade 一个人就是降低其地位。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose steps are being sawed away from below.
abstract.cn: 想象一段楼梯，台阶正被人从下面锯掉。

abstract.en: Picture a cake losing its top layer one slice at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一块蛋糕，顶层的奶油被一片片刮走。

abstract.en: Picture a foundation quietly turning to dust under a standing house.
abstract.cn: 想象一座房子的地基在脚下悄悄化成灰。

examples.en: Terracing reduced land degradation on the steep hills.
examples.cn: 梯田减轻了陡坡上的土地退化。

examples.en: Land degradation lowers yields long before the soil is gone.
examples.cn: 土地退化在土壤完全消失之前很久就已降低产量。

examples.en: The fund pays farmers to prevent land degradation.
examples.cn: 该基金向农民付费以防止土地退化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「land（土地）+ degradation（降级）」——土地被降到更低的等级 → 土地退化

root: land 为日耳曼本族词，更深词根属重构；degradation 来自拉丁 degradare「降低等级」= de-「向下」+ gradus「台阶、等级」，同族另有 upgrade、gradual。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one downgrade: land is whole, pressure arrives, topsoil leaves, salt or nutrient loss follows, yields fall, and the same phrase then names desertification, an economic loss, a global target and any weakening base.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次降级展开：土地完好、压力到来、表土离开、盐分或养分流失、产量下降，随后同一短语用来命名荒漠化、经济损失、全球目标与任何削弱的基础。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slope whose fertile top layer has been stripped to gravel and gullies.
core.cn: 核心意象：坡地的肥沃表层被剥走，只剩砾石与冲沟。

branches.en: QUALITY AND INCOME: the land supports less, and that loss is booked as rural income lost.
branches.cn: 质量与收入：土地支撑得更少，这一损失被记为农村收入损失。

branches.en: EROSION AND NUTRIENTS: topsoil is washed or blown away, and organic matter falls under continuous cropping.
branches.cn: 侵蚀与养分：表土被冲走或吹走，连续耕作下有机质下降。

branches.en: SALT AND DRYNESS: irrigation salts the surface, and drylands move toward desert conditions.
branches.cn: 盐与干旱：灌溉使表层积盐，旱地走向荒漠状态。

branches.en: GLOBAL TARGET: a baseline and a neutrality goal make the process governable.
branches.cn: 全球目标：基线与零增长目标使这一过程可治理。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any supporting layer, from trust to archives, can lose its grade.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何支撑层，从信任到档案，都可能失去等级。

intro.en: Land degradation is a phrase of a native noun and a Latin action noun. The Latin half is built from a prefix of downward movement and a root for step.
intro.cn: land degradation 是本族名词与拉丁动作名词构成的短语。拉丁部分由表示向下运动的前缀与表示台阶的词根构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin gradus 'step' gives degrade, degradation, gradual, grade and upgrade; degradare adds de- 'down'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 gradus「台阶」衍生 degrade、degradation、gradual、grade 与 upgrade；degradare 加 de-「向下」。

items.example: The prefix marks the downward step.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标记向下的台阶。

items.structure: Latin noun gradus, gradus (m., fourth declension)
items.example: The root supplies the staircase image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供楼梯意象。

items.example: The verb first demoted people, not soil.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词最初降低的是人的地位，而非土壤。

items.example: Overgrazing degrades the range.
items.exampleCN: 过度放牧使牧场退化。

items.example: The survey measured degradation of the soil.
items.exampleCN: 调查测量了土壤的退化。

items.example: Degraded land recovers slowly.
items.exampleCN: 退化的土地恢复缓慢。

items.example: The upgrade restored the drainage.
items.exampleCN: 这次升级修复了排水。

items.example: The change was gradual.
items.exampleCN: 变化是渐进的。

items.example: The grain is sorted by grade.
items.exampleCN: 谷物按等级分选。

latinEntries.structure: degradare, degradavi, degradatum (verb, first conjugation; Late Latin)

definition_zh: 地貌；地形（地表的自然形态）
definition_en: a natural feature of the earth's surface, such as a hill, valley or plain
core_image: 地形图上凸起的等高线在坡面上一圈圈收紧
scene: 地形图上的等高线一圈圈收紧，山脊与谷地在纸面上显形。 The map marks every landform in the watershed.
sceneCN: 这里 landform 指「地表的自然形态」（第 1 个义项：山丘、谷地、平原等由自然过程形成的地表形状）；句意为地图标出了流域内的每一种地貌。图中可辨识物件：等高线、山脊线、谷地、比例尺。

pos.zh: 地貌；地形（可数，复数 landforms）

senses.title: A natural shape on the surface
senses.definition: a feature of the earth's surface produced by natural processes, such as a hill, valley, ridge or plain
senses.definitionCN: 由自然过程形成的地表特征，如山丘、谷地、山脊或平原
senses.example: The map marks every landform in the watershed.
senses.exampleCN: 地图标出了流域内的每一种地貌。
senses.why: land names the ground and form names its shape, so the compound is simply 'ground-shape'.
senses.whyCN: land 指地面，form 指形状，因此这个复合词就是「地面的形状」。

senses.title: A class in a classification
senses.definition: one type within a system, such as glacial, karst, fluvial or coastal landform
senses.definitionCN: 某一系统中的一种类型，如冰川、喀斯特、河流或海岸地貌
senses.example: Karst landform covers a third of the province.
senses.exampleCN: 喀斯特地貌覆盖该省三分之一。
senses.why: once shapes are grouped by the process that made them, each group becomes a landform type.
senses.whyCN: 当形状按形成过程被分组，每一组就成为一种地貌类型。

senses.title: A mapped unit
senses.definition: a polygon or unit drawn on a geomorphic map to represent one shape
senses.definitionCN: 在地貌图上画出的、代表一种形状的多边形或单元
senses.example: Each landform on the sheet has its own colour.
senses.exampleCN: 图幅上的每个地貌单元都有自己的颜色。
senses.why: cartographers need bounded units, so a continuous surface is cut into named landforms.
senses.whyCN: 制图者需要边界明确的单元，因此连续的地表被切分为有名称的地貌。

senses.title: A shape with a history
senses.definition: a feature understood as a stage in a longer development, as in landform evolution
senses.definitionCN: 被视为更长发展过程某一阶段的特征，如地貌演化
senses.example: The river's landform evolution took a million years.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河的地貌演化用了一百万年。
senses.why: geomorphologists date surfaces, so a form becomes a stage rather than a static object.
senses.whyCN: 地貌学家会给地表定年，因此形态变成阶段，而非静止物体。

senses.title: The product of a process
senses.definition: the visible result of erosion, deposition, uplift or weathering acting on rock
senses.definitionCN: 侵蚀、沉积、抬升或风化作用于岩石后可见的结果
senses.example: The dune is a landform built by wind.
senses.exampleCN: 沙丘是由风建造的地貌。
senses.why: the word can name either the shape or the work that made it, depending on whether one asks what or how.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既可命名形状，也可命名造出它的作用，取决于问的是「是什么」还是「怎么来的」。

senses.title: Part of a larger landscape
senses.definition: one element within a landscape or region, combined with others
senses.definitionCN: 景观或区域中的一个要素，与其他要素组合
senses.example: The valley landforms together form a single landscape.
senses.exampleCN: 谷地的各种地貌共同构成一个景观。
senses.why: landscape names the whole view, and landform names the pieces that compose it.
senses.whyCN: landscape 命名整体景象，landform 命名构成它的各块。

senses.title: A shape on another world
senses.definition: an equivalent surface feature on a planet or moon, studied by planetary geomorphology
senses.definitionCN: 行星或卫星上的同类地表特征，由行星地貌学研究
senses.example: The rover photographed a landform cut by ancient ice.
senses.exampleCN: 巡视器拍摄到一处被古老冰体切割的地貌。
senses.why: the same physical processes operate elsewhere, so the word travels with the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 同样的物理过程在其他星球也在运作，因此这个词随学科一起传播。

senses.title: The shape of any field
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何领域的形态
senses.definition: the structural shape of any field, treated as a surface with highs and lows
senses.definitionCN: 任何领域的结构形态，被当作有高低起伏的表面
senses.example: The analyst described the market's landform of peaks and basins.
senses.exampleCN: 分析师描述了市场由峰与盆构成的地貌。
senses.why: the metaphor maps elevation onto strength or density, so any distribution can be given a terrain.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把海拔映射为强度或密度，因此任何分布都可被赋予地形。

intro.en: Landform joins the native noun land with form, from Latin forma 'shape, mould'. The compound itself is a nineteenth-century geology term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: landform 把本族名词 land 与 form 组合起来；form 来自拉丁 forma「形状、模子」。这个复合词是 19 世纪的地质术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Land is the Germanic word for ground or territory. Its pre-Germanic root is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: land 是日耳曼语中表示地面或领土的词。其日耳曼语之前的词根属于重构形式，而非实证。

items.en: Forma meant 'form, shape, mould, outline'. Its own origin is debated; a link to Greek morphē 'form' is sometimes proposed through Etruscan.
items.cn: forma 意为「形状、外形、模子、轮廓」。其来源有争议；有人经伊特鲁里亚语把它与希腊 morphē「形状」联系起来。

items.en: Old French forme carried the Latin noun into English, where form named both an outline and a mould.
items.cn: 古法语 forme 把这个拉丁名词带入英语，form 既指轮廓，也指模子。

items.en: By the thirteenth century English form covered shape, arrangement and a document with blanks.
items.cn: 到 13 世纪，英语 form 已涵盖形状、安排以及带空格的表格。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geologists needed a neutral word for any surface feature, and landform supplied it.
items.cn: 19 世纪的地质学家需要一个中性词来指任何地表特征，landform 提供了这个词。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the origin of Latin forma is unsettled, and the first printed use of the compound is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：拉丁 forma 的来源无定论，这个复合词的最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds surface words that are routinely confused with landform; group two holds terms for the study and description of terrain.
note.cn: 第一组是常与 landform 混淆的地表词；第二组是研究与此描述地形的术语。

entries.definition: The visible whole made of many landforms together, including vegetation and water; it is larger than one landform.
entries.definitionCN: 由多种地貌、植被与水共同构成的可见整体；比单个地貌大。

entries.definition: What people do with the ground; landform is what the ground's shape is.
entries.definitionCN: 人把地用来做什么；landform 是地的形状是什么。

entries.definition: The surface considered as ground to cross, stressing slope and roughness rather than named features.
entries.definitionCN: 被当作可穿越地面的地表，强调坡度与崎岖度，而非具名特征。

entries.definition: The arrangement of elevations and the mapping of them; landform is one feature within that arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 海拔高低的安排及其测绘；landform 是这一安排中的一个特征。

entries.definition: Any identifiable part of a surface, including human works; landform restricts the word to natural shapes.
entries.definitionCN: 地表上任何可辨识的部分，包括人工物；landform 将其限制为自然形状。

entries.definition: The difference in height across an area; it is a property of landforms rather than a single landform.
entries.definitionCN: 一个区域内的海拔差异；它是地貌的属性，而非单个地貌。

entries.definition: The study of landforms and the processes that shape them; it is the science, not the object.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地貌及其塑造过程的学科；是学问，不是对象。

entries.definition: A set of landforms that occur together and share one history, such as a glacial assemblage.
entries.definitionCN: 共同出现并共享一段历史的一组地貌，如冰川地貌组合。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: land + form: the compound literally means ground-shape.
normal.cn: land + form：这个复合词字面就是「地面形状」。

normal.en: The family runs land, form, formation, transform, landscape, geomorphology.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 land、form、formation、transform、landscape、geomorphology。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: glacial landform, karst landform, landform evolution.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：冰川地貌、喀斯特地貌、地貌演化。

normal.en: Latin forma 'mould' also gives format and formation, so the shape idea runs through the family.
normal.cn: 拉丁 forma「模子」也衍生 format 与 formation，形状义贯穿整个词族。

normal.en: Landscape is the whole picture; landform is one brushstroke in it.
normal.cn: landscape 是整幅画，landform 是其中一笔。

abstract.en: Picture a contour map where every ring is a level of height.
abstract.cn: 想象一张等高线图，每一圈都是一个高度层。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing shapes into soft ground and leaving them there.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在软地上压出形状，并让它们留在那里。

abstract.en: Picture a graph whose hills and valleys are read like country.
abstract.cn: 想象一张图表，它的山与谷被当作乡野来读。

examples.en: The river carved a landform that floods every spring.
examples.cn: 这条河塑造出一种每年春天泛滥的地貌。

examples.en: Students sketched each landform from the contour lines.
examples.cn: 学生依据等高线绘制了每一种地貌。

examples.en: The same landform appears on Mars in dried-out form.
examples.cn: 同样的地貌以干涸形态出现在火星上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「land（土地）+ form（形状）」——土地的形状 → 地貌

root: land 为日耳曼本族词，更深词根属重构；form 经古法语 forme 来自拉丁 forma「形状、模子」，forma 的来源有争议，或与希腊 morphē 有关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one shape: a surface is carved, the shape appears, it is classified, mapped, dated, read as a process, combined into landscape, found on other worlds and finally borrowed for any field.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个形状展开：地表被雕刻、形状出现、被分类、被制图、被定年、被读作过程、组合成景观、在其他星球上被发现，最后被借用于任何领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: contour lines tightening into a ridge on a topographic sheet.
core.cn: 核心意象：地形图上的等高线收紧成一道山脊。

branches.en: SHAPE AND CLASS: a natural form appears, and the process that made it assigns it to a type.
branches.cn: 形状与类别：自然形态出现，造出它的过程把它归入某一类型。

branches.en: MAPPING: the continuous surface is cut into bounded units with colours and names.
branches.cn: 制图：连续地表被切成有颜色与名称的边界单元。

branches.en: HISTORY AND PROCESS: a form is a stage in time and a visible result of erosion or deposition.
branches.cn: 历史与过程：形态是时间中的阶段，也是侵蚀或沉积的可见结果。

branches.en: LANDSCAPE: several landforms combine into one visible whole.
branches.cn: 景观：若干地貌组合成一个可见整体。

branches.en: ELSEWHERE AND METAPHOR: the same shapes occur on other worlds, and any distribution can be given a terrain.
branches.cn: 别处与比喻：同样的形状出现在其他星球，任何分布都可被赋予地形。

intro.en: Landform is a two-word compound, but both halves are productive enough to build long families: land compounds for territory and form words for shape.
intro.cn: landform 是两词复合，但两半都有足够的构词力，能构成长长的词族：land 构成领土类复合词，form 构成形状类词。

latinIntro.en: Latin forma 'shape, mould' gives form, formal, format, formation and transform; land is native and has no Latin entry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 forma「形状、模子」衍生 form、formal、format、formation 与 transform；land 为本族词，没有拉丁条目。

items.example: The land rises into a ridge.
items.exampleCN: 土地抬升成山脊。

items.structure: Latin noun forma, formae (f., first declension)
items.example: The Latin noun supplies the shape half.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词提供「形状」的一半。

items.example: The ridge has a long form.
items.exampleCN: 这道山脊形态狭长。

items.example: The rock formation took ages.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩层形成用了很久。

items.example: The garden has a formal layout.
items.exampleCN: 这座花园是规整布局。

items.example: The map uses a large format.

items.example: Erosion transforms the slope.
items.exampleCN: 侵蚀改变了坡面形态。

items.example: The map marks every landform in the watershed.
items.exampleCN: 地图标出了流域内的每一种地貌。

items.meaning: the visible whole of a region
items.example: The landscape combines ridge, river and field.

definition_zh: 地貌学；研究地表形态及其形成过程的学科
definition_en: the scientific study of landforms and the processes that shape them
core_image: 桌上摊开的等高线地形图旁边摆着岩层剖面与标尺
scene: 桌上摊开一张地形图，旁边摆着岩层剖面与标尺。 The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.
sceneCN: 这里 geomorphology 指「研究地貌及其形成过程的学科」（第 1 个义项：以科学方法研究地表形态、成因与演化）；句意为这门地貌学课程从河谷讲起。图中可辨识物件：等高线图、岩层剖面、标尺、铅笔。

senses.title: The science of landforms
senses.definition: the scientific discipline that studies surface forms and the processes that produce them
senses.definitionCN: 研究地表形态及其形成过程的科学学科
senses.example: The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.
senses.exampleCN: 这门地貌学课程从河谷讲起。
senses.why: geo- 'earth', morphē 'form', -logia 'study': the word spells out 'the study of earth-forms'.
senses.whyCN: geo-「地球」、morphē「形状」、-logia「研究」：这个词把自己的含义写成了「研究地球形状」。

senses.title: A subfield named by its agent
senses.titleCN: 以作用营力命名的分支
senses.definition: a branch defined by its shaping agent, such as fluvial, glacial or coastal geomorphology
senses.definitionCN: 按塑造营力划分的分支，如河流、冰川或海岸地貌学
senses.example: Fluvial geomorphology explains the terraces above the river.
senses.exampleCN: 河流地貌学解释了河上方的阶地。
senses.why: once a discipline matures, it splits by the force it studies, and each split keeps the parent name.
senses.whyCN: 当一门学科成熟，会按所研究的作用力分支，每个分支都保留母名。

senses.title: The landforms of a region
senses.definition: the collection of surface forms and their history in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 某一地点地表形态及其历史的总体
senses.example: The geomorphology of the basin records four ice ages.
senses.exampleCN: 这个盆地的地貌记录着四次冰期。
senses.why: speakers use the discipline's name for its object, saying 'the geomorphology of X' for the forms themselves.
senses.whyCN: 说话人用学科名代替其对象，用「某地的地貌学」来指那些形态本身。

senses.title: The developmental history of terrain
senses.definition: the sequence of events by which a landscape arrived at its present shape
senses.definitionCN: 一个景观形成现今形状的事件序列
senses.example: The valley's geomorphology includes two glacial advances.
senses.exampleCN: 这个河谷的地貌史包含两次冰川推进。
senses.why: the field's central question is not only what a shape is but how it came to be, so the word also names that story.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科的核心问题不只是形状是什么，还包括它如何形成，因此这个词也命名那段故事。

senses.title: Applied work on hazards and works
senses.definition: the use of the discipline in flood risk, slope stability, mining and road design
senses.definitionCN: 把该学科用于洪水风险、边坡稳定、采矿与道路设计
senses.example: Applied geomorphology mapped the landslide risk.
senses.exampleCN: 应用地貌学绘制了滑坡风险。
senses.why: when a science is hired to predict failure, it acquires an applied branch with its own name.
senses.whyCN: 当一门科学被雇来预测失稳，它就获得一个带自己名字的应用分支。

senses.title: Forms on other planets
senses.titleCN: 其他行星上的地貌研究
senses.definition: the extension of the discipline to the surfaces of moons and planets
senses.definitionCN: 把该学科延伸到卫星与行星表面
senses.example: Planetary geomorphology reads dunes on Titan.
senses.exampleCN: 行星地貌学解读土卫六上的沙丘。
senses.why: the same physics of wind, ice and gravity operates elsewhere, so the discipline travels.
senses.whyCN: 风、冰与重力的同一套物理规律在别处也运作，因此这门学科可以外推。

senses.title: A course or department label
senses.definition: the name of a taught subject or an academic unit in a geography or geology faculty
senses.definitionCN: 地理或地质院系中一门课程或一个学术单位的名称
senses.example: She teaches geomorphology on Thursdays.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周四讲授地貌学。
senses.why: a discipline also exists as a timetable slot and a departmental line, which is how most students meet the word.
senses.whyCN: 一门学科也作为课表格子与院系条目存在，多数学生正是这样遇见这个词。

senses.title: The study of any system's shape
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何系统形态的研究
senses.definition: the analysis of the shape and shaping forces of any system, not only terrain
senses.definitionCN: 对任何系统形态及其塑造力量的分析，不限于地形
senses.example: The lab applied geomorphology to the surface of a metal part.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把地貌学方法用于一个金属零件的表面。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps only 'shape plus the forces that made it', so it fits markets, materials and organisations.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只保留「形状加上造出它的力量」，因此适用于市场、材料与组织。

intro.en: Geomorphology joins Greek gē 'earth', morphē 'form' and -logia 'study'. The term was assembled in the nineteenth century from existing scientific vocabulary. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geomorphology 把希腊 gē「地球」、morphē「形状」与 -logia「研究」组合起来。这个术语是 19 世纪用既有科学词汇拼装的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gē meant 'earth, land, country'. It supplied the geo- combining form in geography, geology and geometry.
items.cn: gē 意为「大地、土地、国土」。它提供 geography、geology 与 geometry 中的 geo- 组合形式。

items.en: Morphē meant 'form, shape, appearance'. Its own origin is not established; proposed deeper links are hypotheses.
items.cn: morphē 意为「形状、外形、外观」。其自身来源未得到证明；提出的更深联系只是假说。

items.en: -Logia 'study of' comes from logos 'word, reason, account', the same element as in biology and geology.
items.cn: -logia「…研究」来自 logos「言词、理性、账目」，与 biology、geology 中的成分相同。

items.en: Morphology was formed in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries for the study of form in biology and language.
items.cn: morphology 于 18 世纪末至 19 世纪初形成，用于生物学与语言学中的形态研究。

items.en: Geomorphology was assembled in the mid-nineteenth century when geologists needed a name for the study of surface forms.
items.cn: geomorphology 于 19 世纪中叶被拼装出来，当时地质学家需要一个名称来指地表形态研究。

items.en: Source uncertain (coiner and first date): the exact person and first printed use are disputed, and the deeper origin of morphē is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（造词者与首见年代）：确切的造词人与最早书证有争议，morphē 的更深来源也无定论。

note.en: Group one holds earth and form words that sound close to geomorphology; group two holds neighbouring disciplines and descriptors.
note.cn: 第一组是读音接近地貌学的地球与形状词；第二组是邻近学科与描述词。

entries.definition: The general study of form in organisms, words or materials; geomorphology restricts it to earth surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 对生物、词语或材料形态的一般研究；geomorphology 将其限定于地表。

entries.definition: The study of rocks, minerals and earth history; geomorphology studies the surface shapes those materials make.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石、矿物与地球历史；geomorphology 研究这些材料形成的地表形态。

entries.definition: The description and mapping of elevation; geomorphology asks how those elevations came to be.
entries.definitionCN: 对海拔的描述与测绘；geomorphology 追问这些海拔如何形成。

entries.definition: The study of places, environments and spatial patterns; geomorphology is one physical branch of it.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地方、环境与空间格局；geomorphology 是其自然地理分支之一。

entries.definition: Of or produced by surface-shaping processes, as in a geomorphic feature.
entries.definitionCN: 属于或由地表塑造过程产生的，如地貌特征。

entries.definition: Relating to the discipline itself, as in geomorphological mapping.
entries.definitionCN: 与这门学科本身有关的，如地貌制图。

entries.definition: The study of the natural environment, of which geomorphology is one part alongside climate and hydrology.
entries.definitionCN: 研究自然环境，geomorphology 与气候学、水文学并列为其中一部分。

entries.definition: The broad group of disciplines about the planet, including geology, geomorphology and meteorology.
entries.definitionCN: 关于这颗行星的学科总称，包括地质学、地貌学与气象学。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + morphē 'form' + -logy 'study': the study of earth-forms.
normal.cn: geo-「地球」+ morphē「形状」+ -logy「研究」：研究地球的形状。

normal.en: The family runs geomorphology, geomorphologist, geomorphological, geomorphic, morphology.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 geomorphology、geomorphologist、geomorphological、geomorphic、morphology。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: fluvial, glacial, coastal, planetary geomorphology.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出分支：河流、冰川、海岸、行星地貌学。

normal.en: Geology studies the rock; geomorphology studies the shape the rock makes.
normal.cn: 地质学研究岩石，地貌学研究岩石造出的形状。

normal.en: The parent form morphology names the study of form in biology and grammar too.
normal.cn: 母词 morphology 也指生物学与语法中的形态研究。

abstract.en: Picture a detective who reads a hill as evidence.
abstract.cn: 想象一位侦探，把一座山丘当作证据来读。

abstract.en: Picture a map and a rock section arguing about the same valley.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图与一块岩层剖面为同一个河谷争论。

abstract.en: Picture a discipline that asks why the ground chose this shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一门学科，追问大地为何选了这种形状。

examples.en: Geomorphology explains why the river keeps shifting its bed.
examples.cn: 地貌学解释了这条河为何不断改变河床。

examples.en: She combined geomorphology with hydrology in her survey.
examples.cn: 她在调查中把地貌学与水文学结合起来。

examples.en: The paper reviews geomorphology in the drylands of central Asia.
examples.cn: 这篇论文综述了中亚旱区的地貌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「geo（地球）+ morph（形状）+ ology（学科）」——研究地球形状的学问 → 地貌学

root: 希腊 gē「大地」+ morphē「形状」+ -logia「研究」（logos「理性、账目」）。morphology 先用于生物与语言形态，19 世纪中叶再拼出 geomorphology。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one field: the earth's surface is studied, its forces split the discipline into branches, a region's forms are named, their history is read, the work is applied, extended to other planets, taught in a timetable and finally borrowed for any system's shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一门学科展开：地表被研究、营力把学科分成分支、一个区域的形态被命名、其历史被解读、成果被应用、延伸到其他行星、出现在课表里，最后被借用于任何系统的形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contour map lying beside a rock section and a ruler.
core.cn: 核心意象：等高线图与岩层剖面、标尺并排摊在桌上。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE AND OBJECT: the science studies forms, and its name is also used for a region's forms.
branches.cn: 学科与对象：这门科学研究形态，其名称也用于指一个区域的形态。

branches.en: BRANCHES: fluvial, glacial and coastal subfields split by the force they study.
branches.cn: 分支：河流、冰川与海岸子学科按所研究的营力划分。

branches.en: HISTORY: the central question is how the present shape came to be.
branches.cn: 历史：核心问题是现今形状如何形成。

branches.en: APPLIED AND PLANETARY: the discipline is hired for hazards and extended to other worlds.
branches.cn: 应用与行星：学科被用于灾害，也延伸到其他星球。

branches.en: COURSE AND METAPHOR: it appears on timetables, and its method is borrowed for any surface shape.
branches.cn: 课程与比喻：它出现在课表上，其方法也被借用于任何表面形态。

intro.en: Geomorphology is a three-element Greek compound. Each element still builds scientific vocabulary, so the word is readable as 'earth' plus 'form' plus 'study'.
intro.cn: geomorphology 是三个希腊成分构成的复合词。每个成分仍在构成科学词汇，因此这个词可读作「地球」加「形状」加「研究」。

latinIntro.en: Neo-Latin geologia, geographia and morphologia transmit these Greek elements to English science.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁 geologia、geographia 与 morphologia 把这些希腊成分传给英语科学。

items.example: The last element makes it a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 最后一个成分使它成为一门学科。

items.example: Morphology studies form in many fields.
items.exampleCN: 形态学在许多领域研究形态。

items.example: Geology reads the rock record.
items.exampleCN: 地质学解读岩石记录。

items.example: A geomorphic process shapes the slope.
items.exampleCN: 地貌过程塑造坡面。

items.example: The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.

definition_zh: 地貌学的；与地貌或地貌学有关的
definition_en: relating to geomorphology or to the study of landforms
core_image: 一张地形图上画满剖面线、箭头与年代标记
scene: 图上画满箭头与年代标记，山坡与河谷都被逐一注释。 The report includes a geomorphological map of the delta.
sceneCN: 这里 geomorphological 指「属于地貌学或地貌研究的」（第 1 个义项：与地表形态及其成因的科学研究相关）；句意为报告附有一张三角洲的地貌图。图中可辨识物件：剖面线、箭头、年代标记、三角洲轮廓。

pos.zh: 地貌学的；与地貌（学）有关的

senses.title: Belonging to the discipline
senses.definition: relating to the scientific study of landforms and their origins
senses.definitionCN: 与地表形态及其成因的科学研究有关
senses.example: The report includes a geomorphological map of the delta.
senses.exampleCN: 报告附有一张三角洲的地貌图。
senses.why: geomorphology plus -ical makes a relational adjective, so the word means 'of that discipline', not 'having shapes'.
senses.whyCN: geomorphology 加 -ical 构成关系形容词，因此这个词意为「属于那门学科的」，而非「有形状的」。

senses.title: Describing a surface feature
senses.definition: describing a feature in terms of its shape and origin, as in a geomorphological feature
senses.definitionCN: 从形状与成因角度描述某一特征，如地貌特征
senses.example: The ridge is a geomorphological feature of glacial origin.
senses.exampleCN: 这道山脊是冰川成因的地貌特征。
senses.why: the adjective can modify 'feature' to say the feature is being read as a landform rather than as scenery.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词可修饰 feature，表示该特征被当作地貌来读，而非当作风景。

senses.title: Produced by surface processes
senses.definition: caused by erosion, deposition, weathering or uplift acting on the surface
senses.definitionCN: 由侵蚀、沉积、风化或抬升作用于地表造成
senses.example: The gully is a geomorphological process at work.
senses.exampleCN: 这条冲沟是正在运作的地貌过程。
senses.why: the adjective shifts from the discipline to its subject matter, naming the forces that make shapes.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词从学科转向研究对象，命名造出形状的力量。

senses.title: Used in mapping and survey
senses.definition: describing a map, survey or dataset that records surface forms systematically
senses.definitionCN: 描述系统记录地表形态的地图、调查或数据集
senses.example: The team produced a geomorphological survey of the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 团队完成了一份海岸地貌调查。
senses.why: the adjective marks the method as formal mapping rather than casual description.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把方法标记为正式制图，而非随意的描述。

senses.title: Serving as evidence of past change
senses.definition: used for features that record former climates, sea levels or ice positions
senses.definitionCN: 用于记录昔日气候、海平面或冰体位置的证据
senses.example: Geomorphological evidence dates the old shoreline.
senses.exampleCN: 地貌证据为旧海岸线定年。
senses.why: shapes outlive the forces that made them, so they become archives that the adjective labels as evidence.
senses.whyCN: 形状比造它的力量活得更久，因此成为档案，而这个形容词把它们标为证据。

senses.title: Applied to engineering and hazards
senses.definition: used for studies that guide road alignment, mining or landslide risk
senses.definitionCN: 用于指导道路选线、采矿或滑坡风险的研究
senses.example: A geomorphological assessment cleared the dam site.
senses.exampleCN: 一份地貌评估为坝址开了绿灯。
senses.why: when the discipline is hired for decisions, its adjective appears in the names of reports.
senses.whyCN: 当这门学科被雇来做决策，它的形容词就出现在报告名称里。

senses.title: Relating to other planets
senses.definition: describing surface forms and processes on moons and planets
senses.definitionCN: 描述卫星与行星上的地表形态与过程
senses.example: The orbiter sent back geomorphological images of the crater.
senses.exampleCN: 轨道器传回了环形山的地貌图像。
senses.why: the adjective follows the discipline wherever the same physical processes occur.
senses.whyCN: 只要同样的物理过程出现，这个形容词就随学科一起前往。

senses.title: Relating to the shape of any system
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：与任何系统的形态有关
senses.definition: relating to the structural shape and shaping forces of any system
senses.definitionCN: 与任何系统的结构形态及其塑造力量有关
senses.example: The paper offers a geomorphological reading of the market.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文对市场做了一种地貌学式的解读。
senses.why: the adjective keeps only 'shape plus forces', so it can describe markets, materials or institutions.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只保留「形状加上力量」，因此可描述市场、材料或制度。

intro.en: Geomorphological is the relational adjective of geomorphology, which joins Greek gē 'earth', morphē 'form' and -logia 'study'. The adjective adds the Latin suffix -alis. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geomorphological 是 geomorphology 的关系形容词；后者由希腊 gē「大地」、morphē「形状」与 -logia「研究」构成。形容词再加拉丁词尾 -alis。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gē meant 'earth, land'. It appears as geo- in geography, geology and geometry.
items.cn: gē 意为「大地、土地」。它以 geo- 形式出现在 geography、geology 与 geometry 中。

items.en: Morphē meant 'form, shape, appearance'; its deeper origin is not established.
items.cn: morphē 意为「形状、外形、外观」；其更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: -Logia 'study of' comes from logos 'word, reason, account'.
items.cn: -logia「…研究」来自 logos「言词、理性、账目」。

items.en: The noun was assembled in the nineteenth century for the study of surface forms.
items.cn: 这个名词于 19 世纪被拼装出来，用于研究地表形态。

items.en: The adjective ending -alis 'of, belonging to' was added to the noun, giving English -ical through French.
items.cn: 形容词词尾 -alis「属于…的」加在名词上，经法语形成英语 -ical。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first use of the adjective is not recorded separately from the noun, and the deeper origin of morphē is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个形容词的最早使用没有与名词分开记录，morphē 的更深来源也无定论。

note.en: Group one holds adjectives from the same stock that are easily swapped; group two holds descriptive adjectives for terrain.
note.cn: 第一组是同出这一词干、容易被替换的形容词；第二组是描述地形的形容词。

entries.tag: of forms, not of the field
entries.definition: Meaning 'of surface form or the processes making it'; it describes the object, while geomorphological describes the discipline or a formal study.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「地表形态或其塑造过程的」；描述对象，而 geomorphological 描述学科或正式研究。

entries.definition: Relating to geology and earth materials; a geological map shows rock units, a geomorphological map shows surface shapes.
entries.definitionCN: 与地质学及地球物质有关；地质图显示岩层单元，地貌图显示地表形态。

entries.definition: Relating to the study of form in any field; it lacks the earth-specific geo- element.
entries.definitionCN: 与任何领域的形态研究有关；缺少专指地球的 geo- 成分。

entries.definition: Relating to places and spatial distribution; it does not focus on how a surface form was made.
entries.definitionCN: 与地方及空间分布有关；不聚焦于地表形态如何形成。

entries.definition: Relating to the description of elevation; it gives heights without explaining their origin.
entries.definitionCN: 与海拔描述有关；给出高度，不解释成因。

entries.definition: Relating to the surface layer of the ground; it names the layer, not the science of its shapes.
entries.definitionCN: 与地表层有关；命名该层，而非研究其形状的学科。

entries.definition: A descriptive phrase for anything connected with landforms, without naming a discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 指与地貌有关的任何事物的描述性说法，不命名学科。

entries.definition: Relating to the natural side of geography, including landforms, climate and water.
entries.definitionCN: 与地理学的自然方面有关，包括地貌、气候与水。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -ical turns the discipline into an adjective: 'of geomorphology'.
normal.cn: -ical 把学科变成形容词：「属于地貌学的」。

normal.en: The family runs geomorphology, geomorphologist, geomorphological, geomorphologically, geomorphic.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 geomorphology、geomorphologist、geomorphological、geomorphologically、geomorphic。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: geomorphological map, survey, evidence, evolution.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：地貌图、地貌调查、地貌证据、地貌演化。

normal.en: Geo- earth, morphē form, -logy study, -ical of: the whole word is a recipe.
normal.cn: geo- 地球、morphē 形状、-logy 研究、-ical …的：整个词就是一份配方。

normal.en: A geological map shows rock; a geomorphological map shows shape.
normal.cn: 地质图显示岩石，地貌图显示形状。

abstract.en: Picture a report that reads a hill like a sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象一份报告，把一座山丘当作句子来读。

abstract.en: Picture arrows drawn on a slope to show where the past went.
abstract.cn: 想象坡上画着箭头，指出过去走向了哪里。

abstract.en: Picture a map that explains, not just locates.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，它不只定位，还做解释。

examples.en: The geomorphological survey identified two old river terraces.
examples.cn: 这次地貌调查确认了两级古老河流阶地。

examples.en: Geomorphological evidence points to a wetter past.
examples.cn: 地貌证据指向一个更湿润的过去。

examples.en: The paper combines geomorphological and hydrological data.
examples.cn: 这篇论文结合了地貌学与水文数据。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「geomorphology（地貌学）+ ical（…的）」——属于地貌学的 → 地貌学的

root: geo-（希腊 gē「大地」）+ morphē「形状」+ -logia「研究」+ 拉丁形容词词尾 -alis（英语 -ical）。是 geomorphology 的关系形容词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one adjective: it points to the discipline, then to a described feature, a shaping process, a map or survey, a line of evidence, an applied assessment, another planet, and finally any system's structure.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个形容词展开：先指向学科，再指向被描述的特征、塑造过程、地图或调查、证据线、应用评估、另一颗行星，最后指任何系统的结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contour sheet covered with section lines, arrows and date marks.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张画满剖面线、箭头与年代标记的等高线图。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE AND MAPPING: the adjective marks work done under the discipline, especially formal maps and surveys.
branches.cn: 学科与制图：形容词标记在该学科下完成的工作，尤其是正式地图与调查。

branches.en: DESCRIBED FEATURE: a hill or ridge is read as a landform rather than as scenery.
branches.cn: 被描述的特征：山丘或山脊被读作地貌，而非风景。

branches.en: PROCESS: erosion, deposition and uplift are named as the makers of shape.
branches.cn: 过程：侵蚀、沉积与抬升被命名为形状的制造者。

branches.en: EVIDENCE AND APPLICATION: shapes date past climates, and assessments guide engineering decisions.
branches.cn: 证据与应用：形状为过去气候定年，评估指导工程决策。

branches.en: ELSEWHERE AND METAPHOR: the adjective travels to other planets and to the structure of any system.
branches.cn: 别处与比喻：形容词前往其他行星，也用于任何系统的结构。

intro.en: Geomorphological stacks four elements: earth, form, study and 'of'. Each is still productive, which is why the word feels transparent to readers who know the pieces.
intro.cn: geomorphological 叠了四个成分：大地、形状、研究、…的。每个成分仍有构词力，因此懂这些部件的人会觉得这个词很透明。

latinIntro.en: Neo-Latin geologia and morphologia carry the Greek elements; the Latin suffix -alis supplies the adjective ending.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁 geologia 与 morphologia 承载这些希腊成分；拉丁词尾 -alis 提供形容词结尾。

items.exampleCN: 报告附有一张三角洲的地貌图。

items.example: The coast is geomorphologically young.

items.example: The geomorphologist dated the terrace.
