definition_zh: 地貌学家；研究地表形态及其成因的科学家
definition_en: a scientist who studies landforms and the processes that shape them
core_image: 一位研究者蹲在河岸剖面旁，用卷尺与记录本测量层理
scene: 研究者蹲在河岸剖面旁，用卷尺量层理，并在记录本上画下剖面。 A geomorphologist mapped the old river terraces.
sceneCN: 这里 geomorphologist 指「以地貌为研究对象的科学家」（第 1 个义项：研究地表形态及其形成过程的专业人员）；句意为一位地貌学家测绘了古老的河流阶地。图中可辨识物件：河岸剖面、卷尺、记录本、阶地轮廓。

pos.zh: 地貌学家（可数，复数 geomorphologists）

senses.title: A scientist of landforms
senses.definition: a person who studies surface forms and the processes that produce them
senses.definitionCN: 研究地表形态及其形成过程的人
senses.example: A geomorphologist mapped the old river terraces.
senses.exampleCN: 一位地貌学家测绘了古老的河流阶地。
senses.why: geomorphology plus -ist 'person who practises' names the practitioner of the discipline.
senses.whyCN: geomorphology 加 -ist「从事…的人」，命名这门学科的实践者。

senses.title: A field surveyor of terrain
senses.definition: a person who measures slopes, sections and sediments out of doors
senses.definitionCN: 在户外测量坡面、剖面与沉积物的人
senses.example: The geomorphologist read the section with a tape and a level.
senses.exampleCN: 地貌学家用卷尺和水准仪读取剖面。
senses.why: the discipline is grounded in field measurement, so its practitioner is often defined by the work done on site.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科扎根于野外测量，因此其实践者常以现场所做的工作来定义。

senses.title: A specialist named by environment
senses.definition: a researcher who works on one setting, such as rivers, coasts, glaciers or deserts
senses.definitionCN: 专门研究某一环境的研究者，如河流、海岸、冰川或荒漠
senses.example: A coastal geomorphologist tracked the migrating spit.
senses.exampleCN: 一位海岸地貌学家追踪了移动的沙嘴。
senses.why: specialists add the setting before the title, keeping the title as the base.
senses.whyCN: 专家在头衔前加上环境限定，把地貌学家作为基底。

senses.title: A planetary specialist
senses.definition: a scientist who applies the discipline to the surfaces of other worlds
senses.definitionCN: 把该学科应用于其他星球表面的科学家
senses.example: A planetary geomorphologist compared the dunes on two worlds.
senses.exampleCN: 一位行星地貌学家比较了两颗星球上的沙丘。
senses.why: the same methods travel to Mars and Titan, so the title gains a planetary prefix.
senses.whyCN: 同样的方法可前往火星与土卫六，因此头衔前加了行星限定。

senses.title: An applied consultant
senses.definition: a professional hired to assess hazard, route or site stability
senses.definitionCN: 受雇评估灾害、路线或场地稳定性的专业人员
senses.example: The consulting geomorphologist rejected the unstable slope.
senses.exampleCN: 咨询地貌学家否决了不稳定的坡地。
senses.why: when the science is used to decide where to build, the practitioner becomes a consultant.
senses.whyCN: 当这门科学被用来决定在哪里建造，实践者就成了顾问。

senses.title: An academic teacher and researcher
senses.definition: a person who teaches the subject and publishes research in it
senses.definitionCN: 讲授该学科并发表相关研究的人
senses.example: The geomorphologist taught a course on dryland rivers.
senses.exampleCN: 这位地貌学家讲授了一门旱区河流课程。
senses.why: a discipline also exists as a post and a publication record, which the title can denote.
senses.whyCN: 一门学科也作为职位与发表记录存在，这个头衔可以指代这些。

senses.title: An expert witness in public disputes
senses.titleCN: 公共争议中的专家证人
senses.definition: a specialist called to explain terrain evidence in court or in a planning inquiry
senses.definitionCN: 在法庭或规划听证中解释地形证据的专家
senses.example: The geomorphologist testified about the old flood line.
senses.exampleCN: 这位地貌学家就旧洪水线作证。
senses.why: when a shape becomes evidence in a dispute, its reader is called as a witness.
senses.whyCN: 当一种形态成为争议中的证据，读它的人就被传为证人。

senses.title: Anyone who reads a system's shape
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：解读任何系统形态的人
senses.definition: a person who analyses the structural shape of a field, not only of terrain
senses.definitionCN: 分析某一领域结构形态的人，不限于地形
senses.example: The strategist called herself a geomorphologist of the market.
senses.exampleCN: 这位战略家自称是市场的地貌学家。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the role of a patient reader of shapes and forces, so it fits analysts of any system.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留「耐心解读形状与力量的人」这一角色，因此适用于任何系统的分析者。

intro.en: Geomorphologist is geomorphology plus -ist 'person who practises'. The discipline's name joins Greek gē 'earth', morphē 'form' and -logia 'study'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geomorphologist 是 geomorphology 加 -ist「从事者」。学科名由希腊 gē「大地」、morphē「形状」与 -logia「研究」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gē meant 'earth, land'. It supplies geo-, the first element of the discipline's name.
items.cn: gē 意为「大地、土地」。它提供 geo-，即学科名的第一个成分。

items.en: Morphē meant 'form, shape'; its deeper origin is not established.
items.cn: morphē 意为「形状、外形」；其更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: -Logia 'study of' comes from logos 'word, reason, account'.
items.cn: -logia「…研究」来自 logos「言词、理性、账目」。

items.en: The discipline's name was assembled in the nineteenth century from these Greek elements.
items.cn: 学科名于 19 世纪由这些希腊成分拼装而成。

items.en: The suffix -istēs 'one who does' passed through Latin -ista into English -ist, naming the practitioner.
items.cn: 后缀 -istēs「从事者」经拉丁 -ista 进入英语 -ist，命名实践者。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first use of the personal title is not recorded, and the deeper origin of morphē is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个人物头衔的最早使用没有记录，morphē 的更深来源也无定论。

note.en: Group one holds earth-science titles that are easily confused; group two holds nearby technical roles.
note.cn: 第一组是容易被混淆的地球科学头衔；第二组是邻近的技术角色。

entries.definition: A scientist who studies rocks, minerals and earth history; a geomorphologist studies the shapes those materials make at the surface.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石、矿物与地球历史的科学家；地貌学家研究这些材料在地表造出的形状。

entries.definition: A person who studies places, environments and spatial patterns; landform study is only one part of the field.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地方、环境与空间格局的人；地貌研究只是该领域的一部分。

entries.definition: A specialist in form in biology, language or materials; the title lacks the earth-specific geo-.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物、语言或材料形态的专家；头衔缺少专指地球的 geo-。

entries.definition: A person who surveys and maps elevation; the role is measurement, not explanation of origin.
entries.definitionCN: 测绘海拔并制图的人；该角色是测量，而非解释成因。

entries.definition: A geographer who studies climate, water, soil and landforms together.
entries.definitionCN: 把气候、水、土壤与地貌放在一起研究的自然地理学家。

entries.definition: A broad title for anyone studying the planet, including geologists, geomorphologists and geophysicists.
entries.definitionCN: 研究这颗行星的宽泛头衔，包括地质学家、地貌学家与地球物理学家。

entries.definition: A scientist of water movement; a geomorphologist often works with one on river studies.
entries.definitionCN: 研究水体运动的科学家；地貌学家在河流研究中常与其合作。

entries.definition: A professional who measures land boundaries and elevations; the geomorphologist interprets what is measured.
entries.definitionCN: 测量土地边界与海拔的专业人员；地貌学家解释所测内容。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -ist 'person who practises': the word is the job title of geomorphology.
normal.cn: -ist「从事者」：这个词就是地貌学的职业头衔。

normal.en: The family runs geomorphology, geomorphologist, geomorphological, geomorphic, morphologist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 geomorphology、geomorphologist、geomorphological、geomorphic、morphologist。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the role: field geomorphologist, consulting geomorphologist, planetary geomorphologist.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出角色：野外地貌学家、咨询地貌学家、行星地貌学家。

normal.en: A geologist reads the rock; a geomorphologist reads the shape the rock makes.
normal.cn: 地质学家读岩石，地貌学家读岩石造出的形状。

normal.en: The title is built from the discipline plus the person suffix, so it is fully transparent.
normal.cn: 这个头衔由学科名加人物后缀构成，因此完全透明。

abstract.en: Picture someone who can date a hill by its wrinkles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人能凭山丘的皱纹为它定年。

abstract.en: Picture a reader who treats the ground as a manuscript.
abstract.cn: 想象一位读者，把大地当作手稿来读。

abstract.en: Picture a doctor whose patient is a valley.
abstract.cn: 想象一位医生，他的病人是一条河谷。

examples.en: The geomorphologist spent a month measuring the fan surface.
examples.cn: 这位地貌学家花了一个月测量冲积扇表面。

examples.en: A geomorphologist advised the council on the eroding cliff.
examples.cn: 一位地貌学家就受侵蚀的崖壁向议会提供建议。

examples.en: The geomorphologist's report became the basis of the flood plan.
examples.cn: 这位地貌学家的报告成了洪水规划的基础。

root: geo-（希腊 gē「大地」）+ morphē「形状」+ -logia「研究」+ -ist（希腊 -istēs「从事者」，经拉丁 -ista）。是 geomorphology 的从业者名称。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one person: a scientist studies forms, measures them in the field, specialises by environment, extends to planets, is hired as a consultant, teaches and publishes, testifies in disputes, and finally reads the shape of any system.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个人展开：科学家研究形态、在野外测量、按环境分科、延伸到行星、受雇为顾问、教学与发表、在争议中作证，最后解读任何系统的形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a researcher kneeling at a river bank section with a tape and a notebook.
core.cn: 核心意象：研究者蹲在河岸剖面旁，拿着卷尺与记录本。

branches.en: THE ROLE: the title names the person, whether teaching in a department or studying forms.
branches.cn: 角色：头衔命名这个人，无论他在院系教书还是研究形态。

branches.en: FIELDWORK: slopes, sections and sediments are measured on site with tape and level.
branches.cn: 野外工作：坡面、剖面与沉积物在现场用卷尺与水准仪测量。

branches.en: SPECIALISMS: the title takes a prefix for rivers, coasts, glaciers or other planets.
branches.cn: 专长：头衔可加河流、海岸、冰川或其他行星的前缀。

branches.en: APPLIED: the practitioner is hired to judge hazard, route and site stability.
branches.cn: 应用：实践者受雇判断灾害、路线与场地稳定性。

branches.en: WITNESS AND METAPHOR: the expert explains terrain in a dispute, and the role is borrowed for any system's shape.
branches.cn: 证人与比喻：专家在争议中解释地形，这一角色也被借用于任何系统的形态。

intro.en: Geomorphologist is a four-element word: earth, form, study and person. The last suffix is the only element that turns a discipline into an occupation.
intro.cn: geomorphologist 是四成分词：大地、形状、研究、人。最后的后缀是唯一把这个学科变成职业的成分。

latinIntro.en: Neo-Latin geologia and morphologia carry the Greek elements; Latin -ista, from Greek -istēs, supplies the person suffix.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁 geologia 与 morphologia 承载希腊成分；拉丁 -ista（来自希腊 -istēs）提供人物后缀。
